concepts/abiotic-correlates-of-prophage-.title: Abiotic correlates of prophage burden in metagenomes
concepts/abiotic-correlates-of-prophage-.description: Whether taxonomy-inferred prophage burden in environmental metagenomes correlates with abiotic variables such as pH and temperature, and whether this agrees with pangenome-based enrichment; covers inference caveats.

concepts/accessory-conservation-of-metal.title: Accessory conservation of metal and antibiotic resistance genes
concepts/accessory-conservation-of-metal.description: Whether genes important under metal stress or antibiotics are less conserved, consistent with mobile-element acquisition; hypotheses about core versus accessory responses.

concepts/accessory-gene-content-enrichme.title: Accessory gene-content enrichment in subsurface lineages relative to soil congeners
concepts/accessory-gene-content-enrichme.description: Per-orthogroup enrichment tests contrasting deep subsurface (clay borehole/porewater) genomes with phylum-matched soil genomes, including functional categories of enriched OGs; stops at genome-size questions.

concepts/active-learning-for-selecting-g.title: Active learning for selecting growth experiments from model errors
concepts/active-learning-for-selecting-g.description: Using confident prediction errors, model uncertainty and field relevance to rank new growth experiments, and how such a ranking is to be validated; it stops at wet-lab outcomes.

concepts/adsorption-receptors-versus-def.title: Adsorption receptors versus defense systems as determinants of phage host range
concepts/adsorption-receptors-versus-def.description: How phage-host infection data and pathogen genome annotations bear on whether receptors or defense systems limit infection and what that means for phage therapy; stops at the report's datasets (E. coli panel, four PhageFoundry pathogens).

concepts/adversarial-review-pre-registra.title: Adversarial review, pre-registration and multiple-testing discipline
concepts/adversarial-review-pre-registra.description: How adversarial versus standard review, post-hoc revisions, multiple-testing correction, exploratory versus confirmatory status and citation checks affect trust in conclusions; stops at the biology of any one project.

concepts/alternative-routes-to-toleratin.title: Alternative routes to tolerating lipid A or LPS loss across Gram-negatives
concepts/alternative-routes-to-toleratin.description: Which species-specific substitution routes (sphingolipid, peptidoglycan remodeling, capsule, acylation truncation) permit survival without LPS, and what that predicts for resistance; stops at presence/absence evidence and predictions.

concepts/amr-ecotypes-and-environmental-.title: AMR ecotypes and environmental association
concepts/amr-ecotypes-and-environmental-.description: Whether strains within a species cluster into AMR-profile ecotypes and whether these track environment, host or isolation source, including metadata limits.

concepts/amr-genes-in-ica-fitness-module.title: AMR genes in ICA fitness modules
concepts/amr-genes-in-ica-fitness-module.description: Membership of AMR genes in independent-component-analysis (ICA) fitness modules, module size and cross-organism conservation of module families; stops at network-level enrichment.

concepts/annotation-and-environmental-me.title: Annotation and environmental-metadata table gaps in the Data Lakehouse
concepts/annotation-and-environmental-me.description: Practical limits of Lakehouse annotation and metadata tables for MAG-level and NMDC-derived analysis (empty labels, missing coverage, zero-row or excluded tables, zeroed abiotic features); stops at identifier-format join failures.

concepts/annotation-and-pangenome-correl.title: Annotation and pangenome correlates of gene essentiality
concepts/annotation-and-pangenome-correl.description: How TnSeq essentiality relates to functional annotation (COG, KO), core-pangenome membership and growth medium; stops at causal explanations of conservation.

concepts/annotation-based-false-negative.title: Annotation-based false negatives in comparative presence/absence searches
concepts/annotation-based-false-negative.description: How text-matching (PaperBLAST) and curated-annotation (NCBI) searches differ in false-negative rates for presence/absence claims, and how naming conventions and unannotated paralogs limit them; stops at screening-method validity.

concepts/annotation-based-gene-detection.title: Annotation-based gene detection limits in pangenome trait surveys
concepts/annotation-based-gene-detection.description: How name-based annotation matching, lack of functional validation, rare-gene power and database version drift limit pangenome-scale presence/absence surveys of functional genes.

concepts/annotation-based-prophage-detec.title: Annotation-based prophage detection, prevalence and domesticated remnants
concepts/annotation-based-prophage-detec.description: How keyword, Pfam or eggNOG annotation-proxy detection of prophage genes, rather than dedicated callers, shapes prevalence, false positives and domesticated remnants; stops at executed tool comparisons.

concepts/annotation-coverage-and-annotat.title: Annotation coverage and annotation-density bias in functional enrichment
concepts/annotation-coverage-and-annotat.description: How incomplete COG/eggNOG annotation, composite categories, choice of domain-annotation source and per-genome annotation density change functional-enrichment conclusions and atlas scores.

concepts/annotation-coverage-and-resolut.title: Annotation coverage and resolution in genome-wide cofitness analysis
concepts/annotation-coverage-and-resolut.description: How the coverage and uniformity of functional annotations (legacy SEED/KEGG versus InterProScan GO or Pfam) determine whether cofitness enrichment is detectable.

concepts/annotation-coverage-bias-in-che.title: Annotation-coverage bias in chemical-class callability
concepts/annotation-coverage-bias-in-che.description: Covers whether the chemical class or physicochemical properties of a compound predict whether its catabolism can be called from genomes, and how annotation coverage confounds this; it stops at class-level tests with small numbers of callables.

concepts/annotation-pipeline-concordance.title: Annotation pipeline concordance for KEGG ortholog calls
concepts/annotation-pipeline-concordance.description: How consistent KO assignments are between different annotation pipelines (Genome Depot versus eggNOG-mapper versus bakta) and how that limits cross-cohort comparisons.

concepts/annotation-source-disagreement-.title: Annotation source disagreement and coverage
concepts/annotation-source-disagreement-.description: How annotation sources (Bakta, eggNOG, UniRef50 bridges, KO assignments) differ in coverage and reliability, including false positives for specialty marker genes, and which source to use for which analysis; stops at dark-gene biology.

concepts/antibiotic-dependent-fitness-fl.title: Antibiotic-dependent fitness flip of resistance genes
concepts/antibiotic-dependent-fitness-fl.description: Whether knocking out resistance genes becomes more harmful when matching or any antibiotic is present, and how mechanism breadth (efflux versus enzymatic) modulates it; stops at baseline cost.

concepts/aromatic-amino-acid-biosynthesi.title: Aromatic amino acid biosynthesis and auxin pathway gene coupling
concepts/aromatic-amino-acid-biosynthesi.description: Whether completeness of tryptophan (and tyrosine) biosynthesis predicts carriage of the auxin-synthesis gene ipdC, including soil-versus-non-soil stratification and confounding by general metabolic capacity.

concepts/attached-versus-planktonic-comm.title: Attached versus planktonic communities in groundwater and sediment
concepts/attached-versus-planktonic-comm.description: Covers differences between sediment-attached and groundwater or filter-fraction communities and caveats about sampling offsets; stops at genome-level mechanisms.

concepts/audit-blind-spots-in-inventorie.title: Audit blind spots in inventories of data and its use
concepts/audit-blind-spots-in-inventorie.description: Undercounting and double-counting risks in table inventories and README-based usage audits, including unmapped tenants and missing deduplication; stops at remedies for specific projects.

concepts/bile-acid-7-dehydroxylation-def.title: Bile-acid 7α-dehydroxylation deficit and the ecological cost of targeting bile-acid-transforming species
concepts/bile-acid-7-dehydroxylation-def.description: Pathway, metabolite and paired-sample evidence that some Crohn's-associated pathobionts carry out bile-acid 7α-dehydroxylation, and what depleting them is predicted to cost; stops at generic metabolomics methods.

concepts/biocatalyst-potential-of-uncult.title: Biocatalyst potential of uncultured soil bacterial enzymes
concepts/biocatalyst-potential-of-uncult.description: Whether metagenome-assembled-genome-encoded hydrolases from cold peat Acidobacteriota represent an unfilled biocatalyst niche, including the literature gap and proposed validation; stops at proposals, as no enzymes were expressed.

concepts/biome-abundance-atlases-as-a-pr.title: Biome abundance atlases as a proxy for catabolic potential
concepts/biome-abundance-atlases-as-a-pr.description: Covers using metagenome or 16S abundance of implicated genera across environments to locate potential utilizers, and the limits of inferring degradation from abundance; it stops at occupancy, not activity.

concepts/biome-level-carbohydrate-active.title: Biome-level carbohydrate-active enzyme repertoire differentiation
concepts/biome-level-carbohydrate-active.description: How CAZyme class counts and the glycosyl transferase to glycoside hydrolase balance in bacterial genomes differ across biomes, and which lineages drive it; stops short of family-level substrate specificity.

concepts/biosynthetic-self-sufficiency-a.title: Biosynthetic self-sufficiency as a deep-subsurface adaptation
concepts/biosynthetic-self-sufficiency-a.description: Whether deep-subsurface bacteria show higher amino-acid biosynthetic pathway completeness (self-sufficiency), as measured in cultured genomes; includes ceiling and quality-filter caveats and stops at the cultured clay cohort.

concepts/black-queen-dynamics-in-amino-a.title: Black Queen dynamics in amino acid biosynthesis
concepts/black-queen-dynamics-in-amino-a.description: Whether amino acid pathway completeness depends on accessory genes and community metabolite sharing, as Black Queen gene loss predicts; stops at genomic and NMDC soil evidence.

concepts/calibration-and-denominators-in.title: Calibration and denominators in environmental abundance contrasts
concepts/calibration-and-denominators-in.description: Covers statistical and data-handling pitfalls in genus-level abundance atlases: non-independent samples, rank tests, rollup to genus, denominators and label coverage.

concepts/calibration-of-fitness-phenotyp.title: Calibration of fitness-phenotype thresholds against genome background
concepts/calibration-of-fitness-phenotyp.description: How pre-registered fitness-phenotype thresholds should be set relative to the genome-wide background rate, and what an RB-TnSeq compendium can and cannot test (e.g. missing iron-limitation conditions); stops at fitness-compendium design.

concepts/carbon-pathway-profiles-as-pred.title: Carbon pathway profiles as predictors of environment and lifestyle
concepts/carbon-pathway-profiles-as-pred.description: Asks how well genome-derived carbon pathway profiles associate with or predict isolation environment and lifestyle within a genus; stops at species-level classification and does not cover phylogenetic modelling.

concepts/carrier-weighted-versus-binary-.title: Carrier-weighted versus binary metrics for sparse pangenome events
concepts/carrier-weighted-versus-binary-.description: Choice of metric for rare multi-copy events in pangenome data, comparing binary any-multi-copy flags to cluster-carrier-weighted rates and their effect on detected effect sizes.

concepts/catabolic-direction-filtering-a.title: Catabolic-direction filtering and mis-scored carbon calls
concepts/catabolic-direction-filtering-a.description: Covers how reaction-direction and carbon-versus-nitrogen filters, signature completeness and certainty scoring decide which compounds count as callable, and the errors they introduce.

concepts/census-and-evidence-depth-class.title: Census and evidence-depth classification of functionally dark genes
concepts/census-and-evidence-depth-class.description: How many bacterial genes lack functional annotation, how much residual evidence each carries (darkness tiers, partial clues), and how multi-evidence scoring ranks them for follow-up; stops short of the specific inference layers.

concepts/chvg-chvi-envelope-stress-regul.title: ChvG-ChvI envelope-stress regulon phase structure
concepts/chvg-chvi-envelope-stress-regul.description: Temporal partitioning of the ChvG-ChvI regulon (early, both-phase, late) in response to Fur/SspB release and lipid A loss, including the SigU attribution test; stops at transcriptional cohorts.

concepts/clade-level-innovation-signals-.title: Clade-level innovation signals and their rank dependence
concepts/clade-level-innovation-signals-.description: Covers whether pre-registered clade by function-class tests (Mycobacteriaceae mycolic acid, Cyanobacteria photosystem II, Bacteroidota polysaccharide utilization loci) give Innovator-Isolated or Innovator-Exchange signals, how verdicts change with taxonomic rank, and within-clade heterogeneity.

concepts/classifier-and-database-limits-.title: Classifier and database limits for estimating eukaryotic read fraction
concepts/classifier-and-database-limits-.description: Which read classifiers and reference databases can measure eukaryotic fraction, and how far values are calibrated or comparable across data sources.

concepts/clay-content-as-a-protective-mo.title: Clay content as a protective modifier of soil microbial functional potential
concepts/clay-content-as-a-protective-mo.description: Covers whether soil clay content buffers microbial functional gene content against industrial and geochemical stressors, including correlational evidence and its failure to improve prediction; stops at global-scale soil survey data.

concepts/clinical-and-human-associated-s.title: Clinical and human-associated sampling bias in genome collections
concepts/clinical-and-human-associated-s.description: How the dominance of human clinical and gut genomes in public genome sets skews environment-genome analyses; stops at specific downstream models.

concepts/clinical-sampling-bias-in-envir.title: Clinical sampling bias in environment embedding analyses
concepts/clinical-sampling-bias-in-envir.description: Whether the clinical over-representation in the AlphaEarth genome subset and the choice of species classification confound environment–gene content associations; stops at this ecotype comparison.

concepts/co-contamination-and-multiple-t.title: Co-contamination and multiple-testing confounding in metal-function associations
concepts/co-contamination-and-multiple-t.description: Covers how correlated metal exposures, non-independent tests, conditioning on project effects and unreported effect sizes limit interpretation of metal-COG association counts and db-RDA variance explained; stops at the statistical remedies proposed.

concepts/co-fitness-as-a-predictor-of-ge.title: Co-fitness as a predictor of gene co-inheritance in pangenomes
concepts/co-fitness-as-a-predictor-of-ge.description: Whether gene pairs with correlated lab fitness profiles (co-fitness) co-occur across genomes more than prevalence-matched random pairs, including per-organism effect sizes; stops at module-level and phylogenetic questions.

concepts/co-occurrence-and-modularity-of.title: Co-occurrence and modularity of catabolic capacities across genomes
concepts/co-occurrence-and-modularity-of.description: Covers whether genomes carrying one catabolic capacity tend to carry others, whether capacities form portable modules, and the effect-size methods used to test this; it stops at genome-level presence data.

concepts/co-occurrence-network-structure.title: Co-occurrence network structure and metal-tolerance guilds
concepts/co-occurrence-network-structure.description: Whether genera with high metal-gene density have more co-occurrence partners, what those partners look like, and how far the signal is independent of niche breadth; stops at causal assembly mechanisms.

concepts/co-occurrence-of-plant-growth-p.title: Co-occurrence of plant-growth-promoting genes and trait guilds
concepts/co-occurrence-of-plant-growth-p.description: Whether plant-growth-promoting (PGP) genes such as pqqC, acdS, hcnC, ipdC and nifH co-occur across species, forming modules or separate ecological guilds; stops at gene-level presence/absence, not physical linkage.

concepts/coarse-cog-fraction-proxies-ver.title: Coarse COG-fraction proxies versus pathway-level stress evidence
concepts/coarse-cog-fraction-proxies-ver.description: Limits of broad COG-category functional proxies, annotation conventions and genus aggregation for detecting metal-response functional effects.

concepts/community-function-of-rare-eart.title: Community function of rare-earth acid mine drainage MAGs
concepts/community-function-of-rare-eart.description: Taxonomy and stress-response gene content of metagenome-assembled genomes from REE-impacted acid mine drainage and their lack of methylotrophy markers.

concepts/community-level-niche-coverage-.title: Community-level niche coverage and resource depletion for competitive exclusion
concepts/community-level-niche-coverage-.description: Whether no single commensal outcompetes a pathogen on its substrates and communities must jointly cover its niche, with growth-kinetics and lag evidence; stops at specific formulation rankings.

concepts/compartment-specific-functional.title: Compartment-specific functional differentiation of plant-associated bacteria
concepts/compartment-specific-functional.description: Whether root, rhizosphere and phyllosphere bacteria differ in functional marker content, including effect size, location-versus-dispersion decomposition and sensitivity to dominant genome-rich species.

concepts/complexity-hypothesis-regulator.title: Complexity hypothesis: regulatory versus metabolic gene transfer asymmetry
concepts/complexity-hypothesis-regulator.description: Covers whether regulatory genes are transferred less or more than metabolic genes across the bacterial tree, and the role of architectural promiscuity; stops at mobile-element mechanisms.

concepts/compositional-coupling-in-metag.title: Compositional coupling in metagenomic validation of carrier abundance
concepts/compositional-coupling-in-metag.description: Independent metagenome-based validation of lab-derived predictions using genus-level taxon bridges, and how abundant ubiquitous genera inflate correlations; stops at the NMDC-based tests in this report.

concepts/compound-identifier-ambiguity-i.title: Compound identifier ambiguity in linking metabolites to metabolic models
concepts/compound-identifier-ambiguity-i.description: How exact-name versus formula-only matching of measured metabolites to biochemistry databases and pathway tools yields definitive, ambiguous or failed links; stops at the matching step, not model predictions.

concepts/concordance-between-cross-genus.title: Concordance between cross-genus predictive genes and within-strain gene fitness
concepts/concordance-between-cross-genus.description: Whether genes that predict growth across genera in a model are also genes whose disruption alters fitness in matched RB-TnSeq experiments, and why the two can disagree; it stops at model performance itself.

concepts/concordance-between-laboratory-.title: Concordance between laboratory fitness phenotypes and field environments of gene carriers
concepts/concordance-between-laboratory-.description: Whether the condition under which a gene matters in the lab predicts the environments of genomes that carry it; covers within-species carrier tests, pre-registered lab–field concordance and its statistical caveats.

concepts/concordance-of-genome-scale-met.title: Concordance of genome-scale metabolic model predictions with experimental data
concepts/concordance-of-genome-scale-met.description: How well flux balance analysis and draft automated model predictions agree with experimental gene essentiality (TnSeq or knockout lethality) and carbon-source growth, and how gapfilling and media assumptions limit that agreement; stops at growth-rate prediction within dispensable genes.

concepts/condition-dependent-fitness-tra.title: Condition-dependent fitness trade-offs of core versus accessory genes
concepts/condition-dependent-fitness-tra.description: Genes important in some conditions and burdensome in others, and whether core genes are enriched for such trade-offs relative to accessory genes; stops at laboratory knockout evidence.

concepts/condition-dependent-respiratory.title: Condition-dependent respiratory chain configuration
concepts/condition-dependent-respiratory.description: Covers how which respiratory components (NADH dehydrogenases, terminal oxidases, SDH) are required varies by carbon source in a bacterium, and why; stops short of general cross-species claims.

concepts/condition-specific-fitness-corr.title: Condition-specific fitness correlation across carbon sources
concepts/condition-specific-fitness-corr.description: How mutant growth fitness correlates across carbon-source conditions and what that shows about shared versus independent gene sets; stops at single-organism data.

concepts/condition-specific-fitness-of-d.title: Condition-specific fitness of dark genes
concepts/condition-specific-fitness-of-d.description: In which experimental conditions dark genes show strong fitness effects (stress versus nutrient/community), and caveats such as polar effects and operon context.

concepts/condition-specific-gene-importa.title: Condition-specific gene importance across carbon sources
concepts/condition-specific-gene-importa.description: How growth defects of deletion mutants vary across carbon sources and overlap between conditions; stops at model predictions.

concepts/condition-specific-gene-phenoty.title: Condition-specific gene phenotypes and functional annotation yield
concepts/condition-specific-gene-phenoty.description: How genes whose growth importance concentrates on one condition recover known pathways and add annotation value; stops at the per-condition specificity analysis of a single deletion collection.

concepts/confounding-and-robustness-in-e.title: Confounding and robustness in environmental metabolomics–genomics association
concepts/confounding-and-robustness-in-e.description: How study structure, ecosystem stratification, missing abiotic covariates, compound-mapping errors and sample size limit inference when pairing community pathway completeness with metabolomics.

concepts/confounding-of-compound-source-.title: Confounding of compound source with chemical class
concepts/confounding-of-compound-source-.description: Covers whether compound origin (groundwater versus necromass) can be separated from chemical class when assessing utilization, and where it cannot.

concepts/conservation-of-amino-acid-bios.title: Conservation of amino acid biosynthesis pathways across bacteria
concepts/conservation-of-amino-acid-bios.description: Whether amino acid biosynthesis is near-universally complete in free-living bacteria per GapMind, including the single serine gap in Desulfovibrio vulgaris; stops short of experimental essentiality.

concepts/conservation-of-cofitness-modul.title: Conservation of cofitness modules across genomes and organisms
concepts/conservation-of-cofitness-modul.description: Whether ICA fitness modules are conserved, core-enriched or co-inherited across genomes beyond prevalence-matched random gene sets, and whether family breadth tracks conservation.

concepts/conservation-of-cofitness-modul.title: Conservation of cofitness modules in the core genome
concepts/conservation-of-cofitness-modul.description: Whether genes in co-regulated fitness (ICA) modules are more often core than other genes, and how module conservation is distributed; stops at module-level composition, not mechanisms of selection.

concepts/conserved-metal-phenotype-gene-.title: Conserved metal-phenotype gene families and novel metal-tolerance candidates
concepts/conserved-metal-phenotype-gene-.description: Ortholog families with metal fitness phenotypes across organisms, whether specificity classes match metal-resistance annotations, and how unannotated candidate families differ in specificity, pleiotropy and pangenome conservation; stops at predictions awaiting validation.

concepts/conserved-multi-metal-tolerance.title: Conserved multi-metal tolerance gene families
concepts/conserved-multi-metal-tolerance.description: Ortholog groups important for multiple metals across several organisms, their functions, and their potential use in engineering tolerance or bioremediation.

concepts/constitutive-versus-inducible-g.title: Constitutive versus inducible gene classes in niche-breadth associations
concepts/constitutive-versus-inducible-g.description: Why metal cofactor-biosynthesis genes track niche breadth like housekeeping genes while resistance, regulatory and non-metal transporter gene sets show null associations; covers true-negative categories, split-magnitude permutations and jackknives.

concepts/construction-and-validity-of-co.title: Construction and validity of cofitness gene groups
concepts/construction-and-validity-of-co.description: How matrix decomposition yields cofitness gene groups, how thresholds, experiment counts, adjacency and missing-data or operon handling affect their validity; stops at conservation.

concepts/contamination-and-metal-gradien.title: Contamination and metal gradients as drivers of community functional potential
concepts/contamination-and-metal-gradien.description: Whether contaminant or measured metal gradients shift community stress-related functional potential, including sensitivity to contamination index construction; observational only.

concepts/continuous-versus-binary-predic.title: Continuous versus binary predictors of gene essentiality
concepts/continuous-versus-binary-predic.description: Comparison of continuous fitness, aggregated essentiality fraction and protein expression level as predictors of knockout essentiality by ROC AUC; stops at integration methods.

concepts/continuous-versus-discrete-stru.title: Continuous versus discrete structure of condition-dependent gene essentiality
concepts/continuous-versus-discrete-stru.description: Whether gene growth requirements across conditions form discrete phenotypic modules or a continuum, and how many independent dimensions a condition panel provides; stops at gene-level clustering of deletion or fitness profiles.

concepts/contrast-design-and-confounding.title: Contrast design and confounding in testing a putative lipid A-processing enzyme
concepts/contrast-design-and-confounding.description: How choice of pairwise strain contrast (cumulative versus isolating) affects the test of CtpA as a proposed LpxF-equivalent, and why borderline thresholds must be pre-registered; stops at CtpA.

concepts/coordinate-quality-and-institut.title: Coordinate quality and institutional-address artifacts in genome geolocation
concepts/coordinate-quality-and-institut.description: Detecting genome coordinates that reflect institutional addresses or approximate precision rather than true sampling sites, and the limits of heuristics; stops at downstream use of coordinates.

concepts/core-gene-prevalence-ceiling-on.title: Core-gene prevalence ceiling on co-occurrence signal
concepts/core-gene-prevalence-ceiling-on.description: How near-universal prevalence of most fitness-assayed genes removes presence/absence variance and attenuates phi-based co-occurrence tests, including zero-variance NaN cases and co-fitness strength trends.

concepts/core-genome-enrichment-of-metal.title: Core-genome enrichment of metal-stress fitness genes
concepts/core-genome-enrichment-of-metal.description: Whether metal-stress fitness genes, by metal, organism and specificity (general, shared, metal-specific), are preferentially core, including robustness to NaCl shared-stress correction; stops at gene-level conservation.

concepts/core-versus-accessory-partition.title: Core versus accessory partitioning of gene functions and trait genes
concepts/core-versus-accessory-partition.description: Which functional categories and trait genes (COG, AMR, defense, plant-interaction, PGP) sit in the core versus accessory pangenome, and what that implies for horizontal acquisition versus vertical inheritance; stops at HGT-inference methods.

concepts/costly-but-conserved-genes-labo.title: Costly but conserved genes: laboratory burden versus conservation
concepts/costly-but-conserved-genes-labo.description: Whether genes that are burdensome in laboratory conditions are nonetheless conserved in the core genome, how this varies by SEED functional category, and how burden-by-conservation quadrants and natural selection might explain it; stops at the lab-to-nature inference.

concepts/counter-ion-confounding-in-meta.title: Counter-ion confounding in metal fitness assays
concepts/counter-ion-confounding-in-meta.description: Whether the anion delivered with a metal salt (e.g. chloride) drives measured metal fitness effects, tested by dose-response, chloride-free salts and within-metal salt comparisons; stops at metal-NaCl gene overlap interpretation.

concepts/coverage-and-bias-in-linking-st.title: Coverage and bias in linking strain phenotype databases to pangenomes
concepts/coverage-and-bias-in-linking-st.description: How incomplete name-based matching, uneven phenotype coverage and small validation sets limit phenotype–genome inference.

concepts/coverage-gaps-in-deletion-colle.title: Coverage gaps in deletion collections and their link to pangenome conservation
concepts/coverage-gaps-in-deletion-colle.description: How genes missing from a deletion collection differ from those present in length, annotation and pangenome conservation, and how this biases essentiality and dispensability calls; stops at one species' collection.

concepts/cross-cohort-portability-and-ba.title: Cross-cohort portability and batch dominance in microbiome and metabolomic stratification
concepts/cross-cohort-portability-and-ba.description: Why microbiome ecotype or metabolite clusters, differential abundance and classifiers may fail to transfer across cohorts, given batch effects, m/z bridging and choice of K; stops at translation to specific therapies.

concepts/cross-database-concordance-of-m.title: Cross-database concordance of metabolite evidence
concepts/cross-database-concordance-of-m.description: How well exometabolomic, mutant-fitness, species-phenotype and pathway-prediction databases agree on the same metabolites, and how matching coverage, circularity and medium differences limit that comparison.

concepts/cross-organism-fitness-concorda.title: Cross-organism fitness concordance of dark gene orthologs
concepts/cross-organism-fitness-concorda.description: Whether orthologs of unannotated genes show fitness effects under the same condition class in several bacteria, and whether this differs from annotated genes.

concepts/cultivation-bias-in-genome-coll.title: Cultivation bias in genome collections versus uncultivated lineages
concepts/cultivation-bias-in-genome-coll.description: Which metabolic functions isolate genome collections over- or under-represent versus metagenome-assembled genomes, including absent Patescibacteria; stops at genome-size and taxonomy confounds.

concepts/cultivation-bias-toward-porewat.title: Cultivation bias toward porewater versus rock-attached subsurface communities
concepts/cultivation-bias-toward-porewat.description: Whether cultured isolate genomes from clay-confined subsurface sites represent porewater or rock-attached communities, tested against published community profiles; stops at the clay cohort and does not cover uncultivated MAG-based surveys.

concepts/defense-and-mobile-element-gene.title: Defense and mobile-element gene content as drivers of ecotype differences
concepts/defense-and-mobile-element-gene.description: Evidence that defense (COG V) and replication/repair including mobile-element (COG L) categories differ between ecotypes and links to phage pressure and horizontal gene transfer; stops at the hypothesis level.

concepts/defense-system-burden-scaling-w.title: Defense-system burden scaling with prophage load (anti-phage arms race)
concepts/defense-system-burden-scaling-w.description: Whether bacterial species carrying more prophage-related genes also carry more anti-phage defense systems, after controlling for genome size and phylum; stops at phylogenetically uncorrected tests.

concepts/defense-system-co-occurrence-sy.title: Defense-system co-occurrence syndromes and defense islands
concepts/defense-system-co-occurrence-sy.description: Whether anti-phage defense systems co-occur in species more than expected under a phylum-preserving null, including the R-M Type II × Gabija pairing; stops at mechanism.

concepts/depth-and-hydrogeological-zonat.title: Depth and hydrogeological zonation of subsurface microbial communities
concepts/depth-and-hydrogeological-zonat.description: Covers how vadose versus saturated zones structure community composition relative to well identity; stops at functional process inference.

concepts/disagreement-among-deltag-estim.title: Disagreement among deltaG estimation methods
concepts/disagreement-among-deltag-estim.description: How much the choice of deltaG estimation tool (eQuilibrator, dGPredictor) and pKa source (Marvin vs OPAM2, via the Legendre transform) changes reaction free-energy estimates and sign calls; stops at downstream flux effects.

concepts/distance-decay-of-environmental.title: Distance-decay of environmental embeddings with geographic distance
concepts/distance-decay-of-environmental.description: How satellite-derived environmental embedding dissimilarity grows with geographic distance, and how it differs between environmental and human-associated samples; stops at community-composition distance-decay itself.

concepts/dna-versus-rna-pool-sensitivity.title: DNA versus RNA pool sensitivity to environmental perturbation
concepts/dna-versus-rna-pool-sensitivity.description: Whether the transcript (RNA) functional pool responds more strongly to a perturbation such as warming than the genome (DNA) pool, including confounds from design and timing; stops at individual gene findings.

concepts/documentation-discovery-and-cur.title: Documentation, discovery and currency gaps in lakehouse catalogs and tooling
concepts/documentation-discovery-and-cur.description: Missing catalog comments, broken doc links and tool mis-grouping that leave users without context on a resource, including snapshot age and row counts as the only currency signals; stops at specific proposed fixes.

concepts/domain-based-marker-detection-a.title: Domain-based marker detection and annotation-method bias
concepts/domain-based-marker-detection-a.description: How the choice of detection evidence (eggNOG descriptions, specific or broad Pfam/InterPro domains, versioned domain IDs) changes marker-gene and defense prevalence estimates or produces false absences, and how to detect and recover them.

concepts/dual-nature-plant-associated-ba.title: Dual-nature plant-associated bacteria and the validity of marker-based cohorts
concepts/dual-nature-plant-associated-ba.description: How common it is for plant-associated bacteria to carry both growth-promoting and pathogenic markers, and how marker-panel choice, controls and ground-truth validation change that rate.

concepts/ecological-and-phenotypic-groun.title: Ecological and phenotypic grounding of gene-flow signatures
concepts/ecological-and-phenotypic-groun.description: Covers how biome enrichment, BacDive phenotypes and environmental embeddings were used to test whether atlas findings match expected habitats, and the limits of such association evidence.

concepts/ecological-memory-and-historica.title: Ecological memory and historical contingency in serially passaged communities
concepts/ecological-memory-and-historica.description: Whether prior enrichment history, rather than current carbon source, determines community composition after sequential passaging; stops at the mechanisms behind memory.

concepts/ecosystem-differentiation-of-co.title: Ecosystem differentiation of community metabolic potential
concepts/ecosystem-differentiation-of-co.description: Whether habitat type (Soil vs Freshwater) structures community-weighted pathway completeness, and which pathway classes drive the separation; stops at genome-predicted potential.

concepts/ecotype-aware-per-patient-phage.title: Ecotype-aware per-patient phage cocktail design and state-dependent dosing
concepts/ecotype-aware-per-patient-phage.description: How target lists are turned into per-patient cocktail drafts for a small Crohn's cohort, including hybrid phage plus non-phage strategies, longitudinal ecotype drift and dosing rules; covers the limits of an n=1 trajectory and untested clinical thresholds.

concepts/effect-of-pka-source-on-flux-pr.title: Effect of pKa source on flux predictions across diverse organisms
concepts/effect-of-pka-source-on-flux-pr.description: Whether Marvin versus OPAM2 deltaG changes alter TMFA flux distributions, blocked reactions, or growth across phylogenetically diverse models; stops at experimental validation.

concepts/engraftability-and-lung-adaptat.title: Engraftability and lung adaptation of candidate commensals
concepts/engraftability-and-lung-adaptat.description: Use of patient prevalence, transcriptional activity and pangenome isolation sources to judge whether commensals persist in the airway; stops at the metabolic design.

concepts/entity-class-depth-and-data-vol.title: Entity-class depth and data volume of a biological data platform
concepts/entity-class-depth-and-data-vol.description: Row counts per entity class (genomes, genes, protein clusters, structures, fitness, samples, community profiles, viruses, biochemistry, literature) and how those counts are defined; stops at what the data show biologically.

concepts/environment-dependent-resistanc.title: Environment-dependent resistance mechanism composition
concepts/environment-dependent-resistanc.description: How the mix of AMR mechanisms (metal resistance, target modification, efflux, enzymatic inactivation) differs across environments and what selective pressures it is thought to reflect; stops at gene-level conservation.

concepts/environmental-and-clinical-dist.title: Environmental and clinical distribution of antimicrobial resistance
concepts/environmental-and-clinical-dist.description: How AMR gene load, accessory fraction and conservation vary with isolation environment, clinical fraction of genomes and environmental embeddings; stops at mechanisms of transfer.

concepts/environmental-association-of-la.title: Environmental association of lanthanide-dependent methanol oxidation genes
concepts/environmental-association-of-la.description: How xoxF carriage varies across environment classes (soil, marine, host, REE-impacted), with caveats on environmental classification and coverage.

concepts/environmental-biome-enrichment-.title: Environmental biome enrichment of mobile CAZy gene content
concepts/environmental-biome-enrichment-.description: How T4SS-CAZy co-occurrence is distributed across environmental biomes (marine sediment, crop rhizospheres) and how robust that enrichment is to validation splits and pending null baselines; stops at the biome-level association.

concepts/environmental-drivers-of-genus-.title: Environmental drivers of genus niche breadth and metal-gene density
concepts/environmental-drivers-of-genus-.description: How metal-gene density relates to genus niche breadth along geochemical, climatic, pH and organic-matter axes, and how well environment predicts community metal-gene content.

concepts/environmental-enrichment-of-pla.title: Environmental enrichment of plant-growth-promoting genes in soil and rhizosphere
concepts/environmental-enrichment-of-pla.description: Whether PGP genes are over- or under-represented in soil/rhizosphere species versus other environments, including phylum-controlled and sensitivity analyses and label-quality caveats; stops at presence-based species-level enrichment.

concepts/environmental-niche-association.title: Environmental niche association of defense-system carriers
concepts/environmental-niche-association.description: Whether species carrying a defense system differ in environmental embeddings from non-carriers, and the coverage and interpretability limits of satellite-derived environmental descriptors.

concepts/environmental-specificity-of-pr.title: Environmental specificity of prophage terminase lineages
concepts/environmental-specificity-of-pr.description: Whether prophage lineages defined by terminase large-subunit (TerL) clustering show environment-specific enrichment beyond what host phylogeny predicts; covers lineage clustering, specialist/generalist classes and sensitivity to identity threshold.

concepts/environmental-structuring-of-an.title: Environmental structuring of antimicrobial-resistance gene content
concepts/environmental-structuring-of-an.description: Whether and how a species' isolation environment (clinical, gut, soil, aquatic, host-associated) predicts the number of AMR gene clusters it carries; stops at mechanism composition and within-species effects.

concepts/environmental-structuring-of-pr.title: Environmental structuring of prophage gene modules beyond host phylogeny
concepts/environmental-structuring-of-pr.description: Whether the distribution of prophage functional modules across bacterial species tracks environment after host phylogeny and genome size are accounted for; stops at the lineage level, which is a separate concept.

concepts/environmental-variability-and-s.title: Environmental variability and storage-polymer pathway enrichment (feast/famine hypothesis)
concepts/environmental-variability-and-s.description: Whether carbon-storage pathways such as PHB synthesis are enriched in temporally variable environments and depleted in stable or host-associated ones; stops at genomic association, not fitness measurement.

concepts/environmental-versus-phylogenet.title: Environmental versus phylogenetic drivers of gene content
concepts/environmental-versus-phylogenet.description: How far phylogeny, environmental similarity (including satellite embeddings), sampling bias and pangenome openness explain within-species gene-content variation; stops at GC content.

concepts/essential-genes-and-core-genome.title: Essential genes and core genome conservation
concepts/essential-genes-and-core-genome.description: Whether genes essential for growth in transposon-mutant libraries are preferentially core versus accessory across a species' pangenome, including essential-core, essential-auxiliary, universal, variable and orphan essentials; stops at laboratory-condition fitness beyond essentiality.

concepts/essential-genes-as-a-blind-spot.title: Essential genes as a blind spot of transposon fitness screens
concepts/essential-genes-as-a-blind-spot.description: Genes without viable transposon mutants have no fitness profiles, so fitness-based prioritization misses them; covers how essential dark genes are ranked from non-fitness evidence and tested by CRISPRi knockdown.

concepts/essentiality-and-annotation-cav.title: Essentiality and annotation caveats in transposon-based resistance gene fitness analysis
concepts/essentiality-and-annotation-cav.description: Measurement and classification limits (essential-gene censoring, keyword-based AMR identification, polar effects, relative fitness) on inferring resistance gene costs from RB-TnSeq data.

concepts/field-only-accessory-gene-conte.title: Field-only accessory gene content absent from cultured pangenomes
concepts/field-only-accessory-gene-conte.description: Whether metagenome-assembled genomes carry accessory KEGG orthologs missing from the cultured-isolate pangenome of the same genus, including community-proxy versus per-MAG test designs and the interpretation of enriched modules.

concepts/field-relevant-versus-laborator.title: Field-relevant versus laboratory fitness as a predictor of gene conservation
concepts/field-relevant-versus-laborator.description: Whether genes important under ecologically relevant (field-like) conditions are more conserved in the pangenome than genes important under laboratory conditions; stops at single-organism evidence from DvH.

concepts/field-validation-of-metal-diver.title: Field validation of metal-diversity genera in contaminated groundwater
concepts/field-validation-of-metal-diver.description: Observational tests of whether genera with diverse metal resistance are more prevalent or selected in groundwater and the contaminated, carbon-amended Oak Ridge subsurface; stops at global comparative analyses.

concepts/fitness-cost-of-antimicrobial-r.title: Fitness cost of antimicrobial resistance genes
concepts/fitness-cost-of-antimicrobial-r.description: Whether AMR genes, including mechanism classes, intrinsic versus acquired and prophage-proximal genes, carry measurable laboratory fitness costs and how cost relates to core versus accessory status; stops at costs under antibiotic stress, which are untested.

concepts/fitness-data-coverage-gaps-for-.title: Fitness-data coverage gaps for defense genes
concepts/fitness-data-coverage-gaps-for-.description: How few organisms with genome-wide fitness data carry a given defense gene or architecture, and what that means for testing its phenotype; stops at the Fitness Browser and PhageFoundry collections.

concepts/fitness-measurement-of-novel-si.title: Fitness measurement of novel singleton genes and assay limits
concepts/fitness-measurement-of-novel-si.description: What laboratory knockout fitness data can and cannot say about rare or novel genes and about conservation, including coverage and condition biases.

concepts/fitness-modules-essential-genes.title: Fitness modules, essential genes and condition-specific gene function
concepts/fitness-modules-essential-genes.description: How cofitness modules from transposon fitness data are built, annotated and used to predict function, how essential genes are shared across bacteria, and how per-condition phenotypes behave in one model organism; stops at conservation analyses.

concepts/function-prediction-for-unchara.title: Function prediction for uncharacterized genes by guilt-by-association and ortholog transfer
concepts/function-prediction-for-unchara.description: How cofitness, module enrichment and fitness-module context transferred from orthologs are used to assign function to hypothetical or unannotated (including essential) genes, how far they reach and how they benchmark; stops at group construction.

concepts/function-specific-burden-of-cor.title: Function-specific burden of core genes
concepts/function-specific-burden-of-cor.description: Covers which functional categories show excess fitness burden among core genes versus accessory genes, and why costly genes may still be retained; stops at overall conservation gradients.

concepts/functional-annotation-of-amr-ge.title: Functional annotation of AMR genes and mechanism classification
concepts/functional-annotation-of-amr-ge.description: How AMR genes are annotated and classified (COG categories, keyword mechanism classes, annotation depth, CARD ontology) and the limits of that classification.

concepts/functional-characterization-of-.title: Functional characterization of plant-enriched gene families
concepts/functional-characterization-of-.description: What the orthologous groups enriched in plant-associated species do, whether they are dark or characterized, and which mechanistic hypotheses they suggest.

concepts/functional-composition-of-antim.title: Functional composition of antimicrobial-resistance cofitness support networks
concepts/functional-composition-of-antim.description: Which functional categories (flagella, amino acid biosynthesis, transport, signaling) populate the cofitness partners of AMR genes across organisms, and how network size relates to mechanism and fitness cost; stops at interpretation of causes.

concepts/functional-differentiation-of-g.title: Functional differentiation of gene-content ecotypes across COG categories
concepts/functional-differentiation-of-g.description: Which COG functional categories differ between within-species accessory gene-content ecotypes, and whether adaptive categories differ more than housekeeping ones; stops at the clustering method caveats.

concepts/functional-gene-responses-to-so.title: Functional gene responses to soil warming
concepts/functional-gene-responses-to-so.description: Whether warming enriches carbon-cycling functions and shifts KO-level profiles in soil metagenomes, including horizon differences and per-gene inference limits; stops at taxonomy.

concepts/functional-redundancy-versus-co.title: Functional redundancy versus complementarity among co-occurring genera
concepts/functional-redundancy-versus-co.description: Whether co-occurring plant-associated genera in soil and rhizosphere communities are metabolically complementary or redundant, including effect-size formula error, aggregation choices and pathway resolution.

concepts/funding-agency-and-topic-covera.title: Funding-agency and topic coverage of a shared data platform
concepts/funding-agency-and-topic-covera.description: How tables in a multi-tenant data lakehouse distribute across funding agencies, tenants and biological topics, including ownership concentration and breadth versus depth; stops at project-level usage.

concepts/fungal-community-responses-to-l.title: Fungal community responses to lignin and labile carbon
concepts/fungal-community-responses-to-l.description: Which fungal taxa dominate under lignin versus lignin-plus-labile-carbon enrichment and their known saprotroph or white-rot lifestyles; stops at inference limits from replicate noise.

concepts/fur-derepression-and-transcript.title: Fur derepression and transcript buffering by regulator co-deletion
concepts/fur-derepression-and-transcript.description: How loss of the iron regulator Fur reshapes transcription in Caulobacter, which Fur-released genes are blunted by co-deleting sspB, and whether those sets matter mechanistically; stops at the transcript and fitness evidence for this one strain background.

concepts/gene-fitness-importance-as-a-pr.title: Gene fitness importance as a predictor of pangenome conservation
concepts/gene-fitness-importance-as-a-pr.description: Whether the size, breadth and condition dependence of a gene's laboratory fitness effect predicts core versus accessory status, and what that implies for selection in nature; stops at individual gene mechanisms.

concepts/gene-loss-and-black-queen-hypot.title: Gene loss and Black Queen hypothesis tests
concepts/gene-loss-and-black-queen-hypot.description: Whether costly or fitness-neutral non-conserved genes and pathways show signatures of adaptive Black Queen gene loss, at gene, pathway-conservation and pangenome-openness levels; stops at the genes' identity as selfish elements.

concepts/gene-metabolite-association-dis.title: Gene-metabolite association discovery in small exometabolomic datasets
concepts/gene-metabolite-association-dis.description: How method choice (multivariate versus univariate) must match sample size when linking gene presence to metabolite production or consumption in a handful of strains; it stops at growth-phenotype prediction.

concepts/generalizability-limits-of-plan.title: Generalizability limits of planktonic single-strain inhibition assays
concepts/generalizability-limits-of-plan.description: Caveats on assay design, cohort selection, biofilm relevance and omitted nutrients that bound inference from laboratory inhibition data.

concepts/genome-encoded-metal-resistance.title: Genome-encoded metal resistance repertoire versus phenotype as predictor of metal tolerance
concepts/genome-encoded-metal-resistance.description: Relative predictive power of gene counts, taxonomy and phenotypes for genome-based metal tolerance scores, and the caveat that scores are genome-derived.

concepts/genome-gc-content-as-an-ecologi.title: Genome GC content as an ecological signal
concepts/genome-gc-content-as-an-ecologi.description: Whether genome GC content differs among isolation environments within and across species after phylogenetic control, and how it contrasts with phylogeny-dominated gene content; stops at mechanisms.

concepts/genome-predicted-pathway-comple.title: Genome-predicted pathway completeness and community metabolite chemistry
concepts/genome-predicted-pathway-comple.description: Whether GapMind pathway completeness aggregated across taxa predicts community metabolite chemistry; stops at gene presence versus expression and annotation limits.

concepts/genome-sampling-depth-and-downs.title: Genome sampling depth and downsampling effects on partial correlation estimates
concepts/genome-sampling-depth-and-downs.description: How using all genomes versus diversity-maximizing downsampling, missing-value exclusion and genome count change measured partial correlations and group comparisons; stops at ecotype partial correlations.

concepts/genome-sampling-depth-genome-si.title: Genome sampling depth, genome size and phylogeny as confounders of gene-content and pangenome associations
concepts/genome-sampling-depth-genome-si.description: How genomes per taxon, genome size and phylogenetic structure inflate or suppress associations between pangenome metrics or gene content and ecological traits, and the covariate, stratification and rarefaction controls used.

concepts/genome-size-and-taxonomic-compo.title: Genome-size and taxonomic composition confounding of cultured-versus-MAG functional comparisons
concepts/genome-size-and-taxonomic-compo.description: How genome-size asymmetry, Patescibacteria dominance of MAGs, MAG incompleteness and geography confound apparent functional differences between cultured and metagenomic genomes; stops at proposed corrections.

concepts/genome-streamlining-and-genome-.title: Genome streamlining and genome size in ecological specialists
concepts/genome-streamlining-and-genome-.description: Whether subsurface or specialist lineages have smaller or larger genomes than relatives, and how streamlining inflates per-Mb density of conserved gene sets and breaks housekeeping nulls; stops at specific gene function contrasts.

concepts/genome-type-and-sampling-bias-i.title: Genome-type and sampling bias in metagenome-assembled genome surveys
concepts/genome-type-and-sampling-bias-i.description: Whether MAG incompleteness, isolate versus MAG composition, uneven biome sampling and limited power bias genome-resolved ecological comparisons.

concepts/genomic-discovery-gap-indices-a.title: Genomic discovery gap indices and database representation bias
concepts/genomic-discovery-gap-indices-a.description: Covers how to quantify which biomes and environments are under-represented in public genome databases using indices such as GDI, including the index's construction caveats and sampling-bias checks; stops at specific biome ranking.

concepts/genus-level-aggregation-tree-ch.title: Genus-level aggregation, tree choice and trait distribution assumptions in phylogenetic comparative analyses
concepts/genus-level-aggregation-tree-ch.description: Methodological choices in PGLS and Pagel's lambda analyses: reference tree, genus pruning, count-trait distribution, row ordering; stops at specific biological findings.

concepts/genus-level-amplicon-resolution.title: Genus-level amplicon resolution and rare-taxon limits in matching reference organisms to field data
concepts/genus-level-amplicon-resolution.description: How taxonomic resolution, prevalence thresholds and rarity limit linking reference-collection organisms to environmental survey data; stops at this matching problem.

concepts/genus-level-taxonomy-bridging-t.title: Genus-level taxonomy bridging to pangenome clades and its coverage limits
concepts/genus-level-taxonomy-bridging-t.description: How mapping community taxa labelled only to genus onto GTDB species clades creates unmapped and ambiguous taxa, and how strict, relaxed and species-proxy modes trade coverage against resolution.

concepts/geochemical-and-contamination-p.title: Geochemical and contamination-plume control of subsurface community structure
concepts/geochemical-and-contamination-p.description: How uranium, co-varying geochemistry and a contamination plume model explain spatial and vertical community patterns in contaminated groundwater; correlational, one site.

concepts/geographic-and-biome-distributi.title: Geographic and biome distribution of environmental metal resistance
concepts/geographic-and-biome-distributi.description: Where metal-resistance genes are enriched or depleted across environmental genomes, by grid cell and by biome; stops at causes of the patterns.

concepts/guilt-by-association-inference-.title: Guilt-by-association inference of dark gene function from modules, operons, synteny and co-fitness
concepts/guilt-by-association-inference-.description: Using fitness modules, operon neighbourhood, cross-species synteny and co-fitness to infer functions for unannotated genes, including the limits of single-genome positional heuristics.

concepts/gut-microbiome-ecotype-stabilit.title: Gut microbiome ecotype stability and cross-study reproducibility
concepts/gut-microbiome-ecotype-stabilit.description: Whether discrete community ecotypes inferred from pooled metagenomes are stable across studies, methods, feature bases and external cohorts, and whether clinical covariates can stand in for metagenomic assignment; stops at what the ecotypes imply for targets.

concepts/habitat-and-soil-chemistry-stru.title: Habitat and soil-chemistry structuring of metagenomic functional gene content
concepts/habitat-and-soil-chemistry-stru.description: How KO-level functional profiles partition by habitat and soil pH/horizon in metagenome workflows, and how much of the enrichment reflects taxonomic abundance shifts; stops at single-study NEON evidence.

concepts/harmonizing-free-text-isolation.title: Harmonizing free-text isolation source and environment metadata
concepts/harmonizing-free-text-isolation.description: Mapping heterogeneous isolation_source and ENVO metadata onto consistent environment categories, with coverage and residual-ambiguity limits; stops at coordinate quality.

concepts/horizontal-gene-transfer-and-mo.title: Horizontal gene transfer and mobile elements as a source of novel and dark genes
concepts/horizontal-gene-transfer-and-mo.description: Whether novel, singleton and unannotated (dark) genes derive from mobile elements and horizontally acquired defense modules, using proxies such as composite COG categories, GC deviation, mobile-element proximity and dark islands; stops at proxy evidence, not proof of transfer.

concepts/horizontal-gene-transfer-infere.title: Horizontal gene transfer inference metrics and control-class calibration
concepts/horizontal-gene-transfer-infere.description: Which metric detects acquisition and gene flow on a species tree at genomic scale (Sankoff parsimony, dispersion nulls, DTL reconciliation), and how positive and negative control classes were built and failed.

concepts/horizontal-transfer-of-carbohyd.title: Horizontal transfer of carbohydrate-active enzymes via conjugative machinery
concepts/horizontal-transfer-of-carbohyd.description: Evidence that type IV secretion system (T4SS) and conjugative machinery co-localise with carbohydrate-active enzyme (CAZy) genes, especially GT2 glycosyltransferases, and that this reflects cross-phylum horizontal gene transfer; stops at mechanism, which is untested experimentally.

concepts/horizontal-transfer-of-storage-.title: Horizontal transfer of storage-pathway genes inferred from pangenome core/accessory status
concepts/horizontal-transfer-of-storage-.description: Using discordance between gene presence and family-level prevalence, plus core versus accessory placement, to infer horizontal gene transfer; limited by the proxy nature of the evidence.

concepts/horizontal-transfer-signatures-.title: Horizontal transfer signatures of metal-resistance genes
concepts/horizontal-transfer-signatures-.description: Evidence for horizontal gene transfer of metal-related genes from phylogenetic randomness (Fritz and Purvis D versus Pagel's lambda), plasmid fractions across databases and environmental enrichment; stops at functional consequences for niche breadth.

concepts/host-adaptation-pathway-loss-in.title: Host-adaptation pathway loss in Pseudomonas carbon catabolism
concepts/host-adaptation-pathway-loss-in.description: Covers the loss of plant-derived sugar catabolism in host-associated Pseudomonas lineages relative to free-living/plant-associated ones, and the retention of amino acid and organic acid pathways; stops short of within-infection evolution beyond the cited comparisons.

concepts/housekeeping-versus-substrate-s.title: Housekeeping versus substrate-specific fitness genes
concepts/housekeeping-versus-substrate-s.description: Separating pleiotropic biosynthesis genes that matter in every minimal-medium condition from genes specific to one carbon or nitrogen source in fitness screens.

concepts/independent-continuous-environm.title: Independent continuous environment embeddings versus categorical isolation source
concepts/independent-continuous-environm.description: Using satellite-derived AlphaEarth embeddings as an independent environment definition and how it agrees with text-based isolation categories; stops at GC-specific mechanisms.

concepts/interpreting-negative-out-of-sa.title: Interpreting negative out-of-sample R² in environmental predictive models
concepts/interpreting-negative-out-of-sa.description: Covers how negative cross-validated R² in models predicting soil functional gene counts from environmental predictors should be diagnosed (distributional shift, outlier leverage, true unpredictability) and what it does or does not imply about a biological null; stops at the clay-shield test itself.

concepts/intrinsic-versus-acquired-resis.title: Intrinsic versus acquired resistance gene conservation
concepts/intrinsic-versus-acquired-resis.description: How AMR genes partition between core and accessory genome by mechanism and gene family, and what that implies about intrinsic versus horizontally acquired resistance; stops at gene-level mobility mechanisms.

concepts/iron-acquisition-as-an-aiec-spe.title: Iron acquisition as an AIEC-specific genomic specialization in Crohn's disease
concepts/iron-acquisition-as-an-aiec-spe.description: Convergent pathway, gene-cluster and correlation evidence that iron acquisition and genotoxin loci mark adherent-invasive E. coli rather than all Crohn's pathobionts, with comparator caveats; stops at strain-resolved diagnostics.

concepts/iron-and-sulfate-reduction-sign.title: Iron- and sulfate-reduction signatures in clay subsurface porewater versus rock-attached communities
concepts/iron-and-sulfate-reduction-sign.description: Whether corrected multi-heme cytochrome iron-reduction and sulfate-reduction marker prevalence differ between deep clay, shallow clay and soil cohorts.

concepts/isolation-environment-validatio.title: Isolation-environment validation of genome-predicted metal tolerance
concepts/isolation-environment-validatio.description: Whether genome-derived metal tolerance scores are higher for isolates from metal-contaminated or industrial environments than for baseline environmental isolates, including dose-response, phylum-stratified controls and the host-associated anomaly; stops at the construction of the score itself.

concepts/isolation-metadata-versus-metag.title: Isolation-metadata versus metagenomic cross-validation of plant-associated taxa
concepts/isolation-metadata-versus-metag.description: How pangenome-based plant classification from isolation metadata compares with metagenome-derived rhizosphere and soil catalogues, including concordance, T3SS enrichment and host-specific genera.

concepts/join-key-validity-and-identifie.title: Join key validity and identifier-format mismatches
concepts/join-key-validity-and-identifie.description: Schema-level shared keys that define candidate bridges between Lakehouse collections, and why they fail or silently return zero rows (missing or composite keys, differing ID formats, identifiers with different meanings); stops at taxonomic-name synonymy.

concepts/labile-carbon-effects-on-lignin.title: Labile carbon effects on lignin-degrading community structure
concepts/labile-carbon-effects-on-lignin.description: How adding labile carbon to lignin enrichments shifts communities toward copiotrophs and lowers evenness, and whether this reflects relaxed selection; stops at degradation rates, which were not measured.

concepts/laboratory-fitness-as-a-predict.title: Laboratory fitness as a predictor of field abundance
concepts/laboratory-fitness-as-a-predict.description: Whether gene-fitness-derived traits such as metal tolerance measured in single-organism lab assays predict taxon abundance along field geochemical gradients; stops at this one site and genus-level matching.

concepts/lakehouse-namespace-migration-t.title: Lakehouse namespace migration, tenancy and authentication
concepts/lakehouse-namespace-migration-t.description: Covers table addressing during the Delta-to-Iceberg migration, tenant naming for ingestion, access-denied errors and auth-token handling; stops at query execution performance.

concepts/lanmodulin-clade-restriction-an.title: Lanmodulin clade restriction and xoxF co-occurrence
concepts/lanmodulin-clade-restriction-an.description: Phylogenetic distribution of lanmodulin-carrying genomes and their co-occurrence with xoxF; stops at marker calibration.

concepts/latent-metabolic-capability-ver.title: Latent metabolic capability versus fitness dependency
concepts/latent-metabolic-capability-ver.description: Whether genomically complete pathways are actually important for growth in genome-wide fitness data, including how classification thresholds and pathway category change the latent fraction; stops at evolutionary interpretation.

concepts/limits-of-keyword-and-marker-ba.title: Limits of keyword and marker-based functional annotation
concepts/limits-of-keyword-and-marker-ba.description: How keyword scanning, eggNOG OG tiers, and wrong or unavailable KO markers cause missed or spurious functional signals, and how multi-signal detection (PFAM plus motif counting) corrects them.

concepts/limits-of-transposon-based-esse.title: Limits of transposon-based essentiality calls
concepts/limits-of-transposon-based-esse.description: Biases in calling essential genes from transposon data: gene length, insertion bias, library conditions, absence-based upper bounds, orthology inference and organism sampling; stops at pangenome interpretation.

concepts/lineage-novelty-and-reference-d.title: Lineage novelty and reference-database culture bias across environmental gradients
concepts/lineage-novelty-and-reference-d.description: Whether the fraction of MAGs lacking a taxonomic genus call tracks an environmental gradient (soil pH) as biological novelty or as reference-database coverage bias; stops at taxonomy, not function.

concepts/linking-exometabolic-phenotypes.title: Linking exometabolic phenotypes to pangenome gene content
concepts/linking-exometabolic-phenotypes.description: Whether exometabolite-derived phenotypes such as de novo production fraction can be cross-referenced to pangenome size, openness and gene clusters; covers genus-level availability and the strain-to-genome mapping gap.

concepts/linking-fitness-assay-genes-to-.title: Linking fitness-assay genes to pangenome clusters
concepts/linking-fitness-assay-genes-to-.description: Coverage, mapping quality and exclusions when linking genes from a fitness library collection to pangenome species clusters by protein search, and how clade size limits core/auxiliary discrimination.

concepts/linking-isolate-and-strain-reco.title: Linking isolate and strain records to reference genome databases
concepts/linking-isolate-and-strain-reco.description: How strain and species names are matched to GTDB pangenome genomes, including coverage, losses, false matches from short or ambiguous names, and repairs; stops at downstream biological interpretation.

concepts/literature-coverage-bias-and-te.title: Literature coverage bias and text-mining limits
concepts/literature-coverage-bias-and-te.description: How research attention in text-mined gene-literature collections concentrates on a few organisms and genes, and how text-mining methods, open-access restriction, curated subsets and heuristic classification limit what literature counts mean.

concepts/matching-exometabolite-profiles.title: Matching exometabolite profiles to gene-fitness experiments
concepts/matching-exometabolite-profiles.description: Whether strains and conditions in an exometabolomics database can be matched to Fitness Browser organisms and carbon/nitrogen-source experiments, and how strong the match is; covers strain-level versus genus-level matches and coverage caveats.

concepts/measured-fitness-as-independent.title: Measured fitness as independent evidence of carbon utilization
concepts/measured-fitness-as-independent.description: Covers using measured carbon-source fitness experiments in reference organisms to call compound utilization independently of genome-annotation filters, and its limits for target isolates.

concepts/mechanisms-and-confounders-of-c.title: Mechanisms and confounders of copy-number variation in pangenomes
concepts/mechanisms-and-confounders-of-c.description: Alternative explanations (transposase-driven expansion, dosage selection, neutral tolerance) and technical caveats (paralog clustering threshold, assembly quality, sampling) for observed multi-copy rates; stops at proposed tests.

concepts/mechanisms-of-ecology-linked-gc.title: Mechanisms of ecology-linked GC shifts
concepts/mechanisms-of-ecology-linked-gc.description: Proposed mutational and selective explanations (gBGC, oxidative damage, drift-barrier selection, codon usage) for small within-species GC shifts; hypotheses not directly tested.

concepts/metabolic-capability-versus-fit.title: Metabolic capability versus fitness dependency
concepts/metabolic-capability-versus-fit.description: Whether a genomically complete metabolic pathway is actually needed for growth, comparing GapMind pathway-completeness predictions with measured growth and RB-TnSeq fitness, including pathway-to-gene mapping and coverage limits; stops at pangenome-level evolutionary inference.

concepts/metabolic-competition-versus-di.title: Metabolic competition versus direct antagonism in pathogen inhibition
concepts/metabolic-competition-versus-di.description: How much of commensal inhibition of Pseudomonas aeruginosa is explained by overlap in substrate use versus taxon-specific direct antagonism, including model overfitting caveats; stops at formulation selection.

concepts/metabolic-guild-co-occurrence-a.title: Metabolic guild co-occurrence and redox-driven segregation
concepts/metabolic-guild-co-occurrence-a.description: Covers correlations among metabolic guilds across wells and their interpretation as syntrophy, predation or redox exclusion; stops at causal demonstration.

concepts/metabolic-model-prediction-of-g.title: Metabolic model prediction of growth defects among dispensable genes
concepts/metabolic-model-prediction-of-g.description: Whether FBA class or flux predicts quantitative mutant growth defects among genes dispensable by TnSeq, including threshold sensitivity and per-carbon-source correlations; stops at lethality calls.

concepts/metabolic-pathway-gap-filling-b.title: Metabolic pathway gap-filling by unannotated genes
concepts/metabolic-pathway-gap-filling-b.description: Whether dark genes co-occurring with nearly complete pathways could encode missing enzymatic steps, using GapMind pathway calls and curated domain matching; limited to organism-level co-occurrence.

concepts/metabolic-versatility-oxygen-to.title: Metabolic versatility, oxygen tolerance and metal tolerance
concepts/metabolic-versatility-oxygen-to.description: Tests of whether anaerobiosis, metabolic breadth or H2S production relate to metal tolerance; stops at BacDive-derived associations.

concepts/metabolite-production-versus-ut.title: Metabolite production versus utilization discordance
concepts/metabolite-production-versus-ut.description: Whether metabolites an organism releases (exometabolomics) are also ones it or its species can catabolize, including overflow and cross-feeding interpretations; stops at community-level modelling.

concepts/metadata-and-annotation-coverag.title: Metadata and annotation coverage gaps biasing environmental genome cohorts
concepts/metadata-and-annotation-coverag.description: How missing or coarse isolation-source, geographic and embedding metadata, uneven sampling, keyword-based classification, NaN embeddings and incomplete per-gene annotation tables silently shrink or skew the cohorts that analyses actually test; stops at identifier mismatches.

concepts/metadata-introspection-versus-d.title: Metadata introspection versus data-read access in Spark-based catalogs
concepts/metadata-introspection-versus-d.description: Covers how Iceberg metadata queries, namespace aliases and permission surfaces behave when auditing lakehouse databases; stops at this access pattern.

concepts/metagenome-based-cross-validati.title: Metagenome-based cross-validation of genomic trait predictions
concepts/metagenome-based-cross-validati.description: Using abundance-weighted genus-level trait prevalence to infer community traits in metagenomes and correlating them with abiotic variables; stops at inference-level evidence.

concepts/metal-coverage-gaps-and-propose.title: Metal coverage gaps and proposed validation experiments
concepts/metal-coverage-gaps-and-propose.description: Under-tested metals (critical minerals, rare earths) and organisms in barcode transposon fitness data and the experiments that would close those gaps.

concepts/metal-fitness-breadth-and-magni.title: Metal-fitness breadth and magnitude across metals and organisms
concepts/metal-fitness-breadth-and-magni.description: How many experiments, organisms and genes show metal fitness effects in the Fitness Browser, and differences between essential and toxic metals and between organisms.

concepts/metal-gene-density-and-ecologic.title: Metal-gene density and ecological niche breadth
concepts/metal-gene-density-and-ecologic.description: Whether per-megabase density of metal-processing genes predicts how broad a genus's habitat range is, across domains, datasets and sensitivity analyses; stops at mechanism and at the streamlining baseline discussed elsewhere.

concepts/metal-resistance-co-occurrence-.title: Metal resistance co-occurrence with mobile gene-transfer hubs
concepts/metal-resistance-co-occurrence-.description: Whether genomes with T4SS-proximal GT2 neighbourhoods carry more metal resistance genes, and how that links to the metal resistance niche-breadth hypothesis; stops at association.

concepts/metal-resistance-genes-within-a.title: Metal resistance genes within AMR catalogs
concepts/metal-resistance-genes-within-a.description: The contribution of mercury and arsenic resistance and other stress-response genes to AMR catalogs and the implications for interpreting AMR counts.

concepts/metal-resistance-repertoire-bre.title: Metal resistance repertoire breadth and ecological niche breadth
concepts/metal-resistance-repertoire-bre.description: Whether genera with more diverse metal-resistance gene repertoires occupy broader ecological ranges after phylogenetic control, and which direction of causation the data allow; stops at robustness checks, which have their own pages.

concepts/metal-responsive-ica-fitness-mo.title: Metal-responsive ICA fitness modules
concepts/metal-responsive-ica-fitness-mo.description: ICA fitness modules that respond to metal experiments, how responsiveness and metal-specificity are thresholded and affected by normalization, and how conserved their genes are.

concepts/metal-specific-versus-pleiotrop.title: Metal-specific versus pleiotropic stress gene classification
concepts/metal-specific-versus-pleiotrop.description: How metal-important genes are split into metal-specific, metal+stress and general sick classes by their sick rate across non-metal experiments, per-metal differences, threshold robustness and validation; stops at conservation and candidate-level results.

concepts/metal-tolerance-determinants-an.title: Metal tolerance determinants and shared-stress confounding
concepts/metal-tolerance-determinants-an.description: Which genes specifically confer metal tolerance versus general stress response (including urease-associated nickel handling as a nickel-specific or general predictor), and how genome-based predictions compare with phenotype-based validation; stops at AMR in general.

concepts/meter-scale-spatial-structure-a.title: Meter-scale spatial structure and distance-decay of subsurface communities
concepts/meter-scale-spatial-structure-a.description: Covers distance-decay, directional turnover and well-pair residuals in sediment communities on a small grid; stops at depth effects and functional inference.

concepts/mobile-element-origin-of-costly.title: Mobile-element origin of costly, non-conserved genes
concepts/mobile-element-origin-of-costly.description: Whether genes that are burdensome in the lab and absent from the species core are mostly horizontally acquired mobile-element debris, covering their annotation, ortholog breadth, length and organism distribution; stops short of genomic-context tests.

concepts/mobile-elements-and-horizontal-.title: Mobile elements and horizontal transfer of plant-interaction genes
concepts/mobile-elements-and-horizontal-.description: Evidence from transposase proxies, contig co-location and mobilome data on whether plant-interaction genes are mobile, including the genus-versus-genome scale discrepancy.

concepts/mobile-genetic-element-context-.title: Mobile genetic element context of horizontally acquired gene families
concepts/mobile-genetic-element-context-.description: Covers measuring whether acquired gene families are mobile-element machinery or cargo, via per-cluster product keywords and gene-neighborhood scans, and what these measures cannot detect.

concepts/mobile-genetic-element-retentio.title: Mobile genetic element retention in cultured isolates versus episomal loss
concepts/mobile-genetic-element-retentio.description: Whether cultivation depletes mobile genetic elements and conjugation machinery, and whether genomic sequencing of isolates captures episomal elements; stops at conjugation and metal-resistance markers.

concepts/modular-architecture-and-co-occ.title: Modular architecture and co-occurrence of prophage genes
