concepts/modular-architecture-and-co-occ.description: Whether prophage functional modules (packaging, lysis, lysogenic regulation, integration, anti-defense) co-occur and co-localize on contigs as linked units, and which modules behave as accessory; limited to within-species co-occurrence tests.

concepts/module-level-enrichment-artifac.title: Module-level enrichment artifacts from broad-substrate enzymes
concepts/module-level-enrichment-artifac.description: How pathway-module enrichment can be driven by generic or broad-substrate KOs, and how per-KO step dissection (e.g. limonene degradation) corrects false-positive pathway calls.

concepts/multi-criterion-design-of-prote.title: Multi-criterion design of protective microbiome formulations
concepts/multi-criterion-design-of-prote.description: Optimization of defined commensal consortia under niche coverage, inhibition, engraftability and safety criteria, including size comparisons, uncertainty and tradeoffs; stops at pathogen biology.

concepts/multi-evidence-triangulation-of.title: Multi-evidence triangulation of metabolic annotation gaps
concepts/multi-evidence-triangulation-of.description: Whether combining gapfilling, fitness, pangenome conservation, GapMind and sequence homology can assign genes to gapfilled reactions, including dark reactions lacking EC numbers and how confidence tiers are set; stops at experimental validation.

concepts/nadh-flux-rate-versus-nadh-yiel.title: NADH flux rate versus NADH yield as determinant of Complex I dependence
concepts/nadh-flux-rate-versus-nadh-yiel.description: Covers whether the rate or concentration of NADH production, rather than total NADH yield per carbon, explains dependence on Complex I across substrates, including stoichiometric evidence and untested predictions.

concepts/ndh-2-compensation-for-complex-.title: NDH-2 compensation for Complex I loss across species
concepts/ndh-2-compensation-for-complex-.description: Covers whether type II NADH dehydrogenase presence predicts Complex I dispensability, including cross-species Fitness Browser tests and annotation caveats; stops at NADH dehydrogenases.

concepts/notebook-provenance-and-session.title: Notebook provenance and session isolation in agent-assisted analysis
concepts/notebook-provenance-and-session.description: Covers how interactive agent sessions, shared git clones, in-place notebook execution and review workflows can leave results without reproducible code history; stops at data-access issues.

concepts/ontology-versus-name-pattern-ca.title: Ontology versus name-pattern categorization in pathway enrichment tests
concepts/ontology-versus-name-pattern-ca.description: How the choice of category schema (regex on pathway names versus a curated class hierarchy) can reverse a pathway-enrichment verdict on identical data; stops at the specific biology of the enriched themes.

concepts/operon-organization-versus-func.title: Operon organization versus functional coupling of pathway support genes
concepts/operon-organization-versus-func.description: Whether genes that jointly support a pathway are co-located or co-regulated in operons, or coupled only by biochemistry; stops at ADP1 aromatic catabolism.

concepts/organism-coverage-and-attrition.title: Organism coverage and attrition in cross-organism fitness conservation analyses
concepts/organism-coverage-and-attrition.description: How duplicate strains, uneven organism and metal coverage, missing pangenome links, lack of dose normalization, identifier mismatches and absent essential genes limit which organisms and genes enter cross-organism fitness conservation estimates.

concepts/organism-selection-and-taxonomi.title: Organism selection and taxonomic coverage bias for experimental characterization of dark genes
concepts/organism-selection-and-taxonomi.description: How set-cover optimization chooses organisms for experiments, how the Proteobacteria-heavy Fitness Browser limits conclusions, and how adding tractable non-Fitness-Browser organisms changes coverage.

concepts/organism-specific-versus-mechan.title: Organism-specific versus mechanism-specific wiring of AMR support networks
concepts/organism-specific-versus-mechan.description: Whether AMR cofitness partners are shaped more by the host organism's regulatory wiring or by the resistance mechanism, including module membership and compensation hypotheses.

concepts/pairwise-interaction-among-comm.title: Pairwise interaction among commensals in competition assays
concepts/pairwise-interaction-among-comm.description: Evidence on synergy or antagonism between commensal pairs against the pathogen and data limitations that make additive scoring provisional.

concepts/pan-bacterial-prevalence-phylum.title: Pan-bacterial prevalence, phylum distribution and mobility of anti-phage defense systems
concepts/pan-bacterial-prevalence-phylum.description: How common each defense family (including SNIPE) is across bacterial species pangenomes and phyla, how detection method changes prevalence, and what core/accessory/singleton splits imply about horizontal transfer; stops at distribution, not mechanism.

concepts/pangenome-conservation-of-metab.title: Pangenome conservation of metabolic-model discordant genes
concepts/pangenome-conservation-of-metab.description: Whether pangenome core/accessory status relates to FBA-experiment discordance; stops at ADP1 evidence.

concepts/pangenome-openness-and-its-corr.title: Pangenome openness and its correlates
concepts/pangenome-openness-and-its-corr.description: Whether open versus closed pangenomes relate to AMR load, CAZyme density, pathway variation or environmental versus phylogenetic structuring of gene content, including limits of single-metric summaries; stops at species-level correlations.

concepts/pangenome-scale-prediction-of-m.title: Pangenome-scale prediction of metal tolerance from gene content
concepts/pangenome-scale-prediction-of-m.description: Whether gene-repertoire signatures from metal fitness data predict metal tolerance across species, including bioleaching taxa and normalization issues.

concepts/paralog-expansion-and-gene-copy.title: Paralog expansion and gene copy-number constraint
concepts/paralog-expansion-and-gene-copy.description: Whether housekeeping categories stay near single-copy while adaptive categories expand into paralogs, how core/accessory status modulates this, and whether the Alm 2006 histidine kinase expansion result reproduces at other scales.

concepts/pathobiont-co-occurrence-module.title: Pathobiont co-occurrence modules versus cross-feeding with commensals
concepts/pathobiont-co-occurrence-module.description: Whether Crohn's-associated pathobionts co-cluster in single ecological modules, and whether coupling to butyrate-producing commensals reflects cross-feeding or shared environment; covers consequences for multi-target cocktails and collateral depletion.

concepts/pathobiont-target-prioritizatio.title: Pathobiont target prioritization for IBD phage therapy
concepts/pathobiont-target-prioritizatio.description: How candidate Crohn's-disease-associated species are scored and gated (ecotype-specific meta-analysis, engraftment, protective-analog exclusion, biosynthetic gene clusters) into actionable targets, with the strength of evidence per target; stops at phage availability.

concepts/pathogen-metabolic-adaptation-i.title: Pathogen metabolic adaptation in the lung and stability of competition targets
concepts/pathogen-metabolic-adaptation-i.description: Whether Pseudomonas aeruginosa amino acid catabolism is conserved across lung, CF and virulence variants, and how in vivo expression changes; stops at assay design.

concepts/pathway-completeness-inference-.title: Pathway completeness inference from KO annotations and pleiotropic enzymes
concepts/pathway-completeness-inference-.description: How reliably a biosynthetic pathway can be called from eggNOG/KEGG KO annotations, including pleiotropic precursor enzymes, missing regulators and failed domain-class assignment.

concepts/peptidoglycan-remodeling-and-to.title: Peptidoglycan remodeling and Tol-Pal engagement after outer-membrane LPS loss
concepts/peptidoglycan-remodeling-and-to.description: How peptidoglycan turnover and Tol-Pal components change when lipid A is lost and how the Pal interpretation was revised; stops at Caulobacter data.

concepts/ph-driven-niche-partitioning-an.title: pH-driven niche partitioning and genus co-occurrence in contaminated subsurface communities
concepts/ph-driven-niche-partitioning-an.description: Local co-occurrence clusters of genera in Oak Ridge groundwater communities and whether they reflect a global pH and temperature niche axis; it stops at causal microbial interactions.

concepts/phage-availability-for-gut-path.title: Phage availability for gut pathobionts and the gut-anaerobe phage gap
concepts/phage-availability-for-gut-path.description: What literature, experimental host-range and in-vivo viromic evidence exists for phages against Crohn's-disease-associated pathobionts, how a cocktail is designed from it for E. coli, and where coverage gaps remain; stops at per-patient assignment.

concepts/phage-resistance-versus-metabol.title: Phage resistance versus metabolic cost trade-off at receptor transporters
concepts/phage-resistance-versus-metabol.description: Whether loss of a phage-entry transporter buys resistance at a metabolic price, and whether a defense system that acts at the pore can avoid that price; stops at the ManYZ/lambda example.

concepts/phylogenetic-breadth-and-pangen.title: Phylogenetic breadth and pangenome conservation of dark genes
concepts/phylogenetic-breadth-and-pangen.description: How widely dark gene families are distributed across species and phyla, how coarse breadth classes fail to discriminate, and how full-pangenome orthologous-group counts and conservation tiers change prioritization.

concepts/phylogenetic-confounding-of-env.title: Phylogenetic confounding of environment-AMR associations
concepts/phylogenetic-confounding-of-env.description: Whether environment–AMR associations survive control for taxonomy at phylum and family level, and what limits that control.

concepts/phylogenetic-confounding-of-gen.title: Phylogenetic confounding of gene co-occurrence
concepts/phylogenetic-confounding-of-gen.description: How shared ancestry inflates co-occurrence of gene pairs and how distance stratification limits separating functional coupling from phylogenetic signal.

concepts/phylogenetic-confounding-of-phe.title: Phylogenetic confounding of phenotype–metal tolerance associations
concepts/phylogenetic-confounding-of-phe.description: Whether classical microbiology phenotypes (Gram stain, urease, catalase, oxygen tolerance) predict metal tolerance independently of taxonomy, including Simpson's-paradox reversals within taxonomic classes; stops at the BacDive/Metal Fitness Atlas comparison.

concepts/phylogenetic-distribution-of-ph.title: Phylogenetic distribution of PHB synthesis across bacteria and archaea
concepts/phylogenetic-distribution-of-ph.description: Which clades and orders carry the PHB pathway, how prevalent it is across GTDB species, and which families are enriched or depleted; stops at distribution, not mechanism.

concepts/phylogenetic-signal-of-gene-con.title: Phylogenetic signal of gene content and traits
concepts/phylogenetic-signal-of-gene-con.description: How strongly AMR repertoires, niche breadth, metal resistance and metabolic traits track phylogeny (Mantel tests, Pagel's lambda), and what this implies for vertical inheritance versus horizontal transfer; stops at effect sizes.

concepts/phylogenetic-structure-versus-e.title: Phylogenetic structure versus ecological adaptation in gene-content patterns
concepts/phylogenetic-structure-versus-e.description: Whether gene-content ecotypes and lifestyle-pathway profiles reflect niche adaptation or phylogenetic/demographic substructure, including intra-species phylogenetic control, permutation nulls and clustering limits.

concepts/phylum-level-confounding-of-hab.title: Phylum-level confounding of habitat-specific anaerobic gene content
concepts/phylum-level-confounding-of-hab.description: Whether apparent enrichment of anaerobic markers (Wood–Ljungdahl, [NiFe]-hydrogenase, sulfate reduction) in deep habitats survives control for phylum composition; covers the deep clay cohort versus soil baseline.

concepts/porewater-bias-as-a-general-sig.title: Porewater bias as a general signature of cultivation-based subsurface collections
concepts/porewater-bias-as-a-general-sig.description: Whether cultured collections systematically favour motile, aerobic, high-energy-acceptor organisms from mobile porewater, and whether this holds across subsurface lithologies; stops at the specific KO-level results.

concepts/pqq-cofactor-biosynthesis-suppo.title: PQQ cofactor biosynthesis support in xoxF-bearing genomes
concepts/pqq-cofactor-biosynthesis-suppo.description: Whether xoxF-carrying genomes carry PQQ biosynthesis genes, annotation gaps versus true absence; stops at marker calibration.

concepts/predictability-of-binary-growth.title: Predictability of binary growth phenotypes from gene content
concepts/predictability-of-binary-growth.description: How well KEGG ortholog presence/absence, and pathway-completeness rules compared with machine-learning models (with or without literature-corpus transfer), predict whether a genome grows on a substrate, by condition class and held-out genus; stops at continuous growth kinetics.

concepts/predictability-of-continuous-gr.title: Predictability of continuous growth kinetics from gene content
concepts/predictability-of-continuous-gr.description: Whether growth rate, lag time and yield can be predicted from KO presence/absence or bulk genome features under cross-genus holdout, and what features might be needed instead; it stops at binary growth.

concepts/production-versus-consumption-c.title: Production versus consumption coverage in exometabolomic databases
concepts/production-versus-consumption-c.description: How exometabolomic action codes distinguish de novo production, amplification, detection and no change, what the 2018 snapshot lacks (consumption), and what that blocks; stops short of gene-level interpretation.

concepts/prophage-anti-defense-genes-and.title: Prophage anti-defense genes and host-phage arms races
concepts/prophage-anti-defense-genes-and.description: Evidence on prophage-borne anti-defense genes: their environmental enrichment, genomic placement away from the prophage backbone and the arms-race interpretation; stops at defense-system biology outside prophages.

concepts/prophage-density-and-amr-repert.title: Prophage density and AMR repertoire breadth across species
concepts/prophage-density-and-amr-repert.description: Species-level association between prophage marker density and the number of distinct AMR genes, its robustness to genome count and phylogeny, and candidate mechanisms; stops short of proof of phage-mediated transfer.

concepts/prophage-proximity-and-amr-gene.title: Prophage proximity and AMR gene conservation
concepts/prophage-proximity-and-amr-gene.description: Whether AMR genes located near prophage markers in gene neighborhoods are more often accessory (strain-variable) than distal AMR genes, including threshold sensitivity and heterogeneity; stops at species-level breadth patterns.

concepts/provenance-overloading-of-datas.title: Provenance overloading of dataset labels in the data lakehouse
concepts/provenance-overloading-of-datas.description: Covers how a shared name (such as NMDC) is attached to resources of different origin, tenant, scale and authority, and how that misleads resource choice; stops at general documentation practice.

concepts/pseudomonas-aeruginosa-strain-d.title: Pseudomonas aeruginosa strain diversity and representativeness of reference strains
concepts/pseudomonas-aeruginosa-strain-d.description: How reference strain PA14 differs from clinical CF isolates in T3SS, biofilm and regulatory genotype, and strain variation in genome content.

concepts/realized-versus-theoretical-cro.title: Realized versus theoretical cross-collection data reuse
concepts/realized-versus-theoretical-cro.description: How often the available cross-tenant bridges are actually used by analysis projects, which are idle, and why use concentrates on a few tenants; stops at the design of new analyses.

concepts/reannotation-lag-versus-genuine.title: Reannotation lag versus genuinely unannotatable dark genes
concepts/reannotation-lag-versus-genuine.description: How many genes labelled hypothetical are resolved by newer annotation pipelines versus remain unannotated, the properties of those that resist, and where archaeal and database-coverage bias enters; stops short of experimental function assignment.

concepts/reference-database-coverage-and.title: Reference-database coverage and phylogenetic bias in annotation-gap estimates
concepts/reference-database-coverage-and.description: How over-representation of well-studied taxa, representative-only sampling and reference-genome annotation quality bias estimates of the bacterial annotation gap and its resolution across organisms; stops at the specific analyses' caveats.

concepts/reference-database-table-choice.title: Reference-database table choice and Pfam versioning in Lakehouse queries
concepts/reference-database-table-choice.description: Practical pitfalls when querying domain tables and writing outputs from Spark in the Lakehouse: table coverage, accession versioning, and write locations.

concepts/reliability-and-coverage-limits.title: Reliability and coverage limits of GapMind pathway predictions
concepts/reliability-and-coverage-limits.description: How far GapMind genome-derived pathway completeness calls can be trusted: database coverage gaps, score-category and scope aggregation, resolution for niche-specific metabolism, and agreement with ModelSEED gapfilling; stops at links to fitness and community chemistry.

concepts/reliability-of-kegg-ortholog-ma.title: Reliability of KEGG ortholog markers for multi-heme cytochrome iron reduction
concepts/reliability-of-kegg-ortholog-ma.description: How misidentified or non-canonical KEGG orthologs corrupted an iron-reduction marker analysis and how a domain-and-motif multi-heme cytochrome detector replaces them; stops at marker-calling methodology.

concepts/reliability-of-species-level-ba.title: Reliability of species-level BacDive consensus phenotypes
concepts/reliability-of-species-level-ba.description: How sample size, per-strain deduplication and strain variation affect using BacDive species-level utilization calls to judge a single strain; stops at other phenotype databases.

concepts/representativeness-of-reference.title: Representativeness of reference genome collections for environmental field isolates
concepts/representativeness-of-reference.description: Whether clinical-biased public genome collections and databases represent the niches of subsurface isolates, and the consequences for transfer learning; it stops at name-matching errors.

concepts/resistance-islands-and-co-occur.title: Resistance islands and co-occurrence of AMR genes
concepts/resistance-islands-and-co-occur.description: Detection of tightly co-occurring AMR gene modules within species, their mechanism composition and mobile-element interpretation; stops short of proof of co-selection.

concepts/resource-darkness-of-compound-c.title: Resource-darkness of compound catabolism
concepts/resource-darkness-of-compound-c.description: Covers how many candidate carbon compounds lack a linkable utilization determinant in queried resources, why they are dark, and how to prioritize them; it stops at the claim that dark means unlinked, not unknown to science.

concepts/robustness-and-replication-of-n.title: Robustness and replication of niche-breadth associations
concepts/robustness-and-replication-of-n.description: Whether genus-level niche-breadth associations survive permutation, within-clade tests, alternative metrics, detection thresholds, environment categories, MAG filters and geographic-subset replication; stops at genome-side confounders.

concepts/robustness-of-exploratory-assoc.title: Robustness of exploratory associations to coverage, fraction and site covariate specification
concepts/robustness-of-exploratory-assoc.description: How coverage-aware, fraction-aware, within-fraction and high-coverage sensitivity models change the apparent contamination–defense association and its multiple-testing standing.

concepts/sampling-bias-and-metadata-spar.title: Sampling bias and metadata sparsity in AMR resistome surveys
concepts/sampling-bias-and-metadata-spar.description: How clinical and isolate sampling skew, environment classification, annotation-tool coverage and sparse or noisy collection-date and isolation-source metadata bias inference of environmental and temporal AMR patterns.

concepts/sampling-scope-and-generalizabi.title: Sampling scope and generalizability of pangenome-wide tests
concepts/sampling-scope-and-generalizabi.description: How species selection, phylum coverage and functional-class coverage limit extrapolation of pangenome-wide copy-number results.

concepts/selective-filtering-of-communit.title: Selective filtering of communities by lignin enrichment
concepts/selective-filtering-of-communit.description: How a single lignin enrichment round collapses diversity and replaces a base community with a few aromatic-tolerant taxa; limited to bacterial community-level responses.

concepts/selective-prebiotics-for-commen.title: Selective prebiotics for commensal consortia
concepts/selective-prebiotics-for-commen.description: Whether any substrate favours commensals over a pathogen, from assay selectivity and genomic pathway comparison; stops at validation experiments yet to be run.

concepts/sequence-clustering-resolution-.title: Sequence clustering resolution and protein family definition
concepts/sequence-clustering-resolution-.description: How clustering thresholds (90/50/30% identity) shape the redundancy and family structure of a protein sequence collection, including the arbitrariness of cutoffs.

concepts/sequence-composition-and-conser.title: Sequence composition and conservation of unannotatable genes
concepts/sequence-composition-and-conser.description: Comparison of length, GC, core/accessory status, essentiality and ortholog breadth between persistently unannotated and later-annotated genes, including confounds such as gene length.

concepts/shallow-alphafold-msa-depth-and.title: Shallow AlphaFold MSA depth and annotation of conserved core genes
concepts/shallow-alphafold-msa-depth-and.description: Covers how AlphaFold multiple-sequence-alignment (MSA) depth relates to annotation richness (InterPro hits and families) across pangenome classes, including universally conserved but unannotated core genes with shallow MSAs; stops short of experimental characterisation of function.

concepts/shared-dispensability-as-a-conf.title: Shared dispensability as a confound in cofitness enrichment
concepts/shared-dispensability-as-a-conf.description: Whether functional enrichment in cofitness neighborhoods reflects genuine co-regulation or shared laboratory dispensability of genes, and the permutation tests that would separate them; stops at AMR-specific mechanism comparisons.

concepts/shared-metal-and-osmotic-stress.title: Shared metal and osmotic stress fitness determinants
concepts/shared-metal-and-osmotic-stress.description: How much of the gene-level fitness response to metals overlaps with the response to NaCl (osmotic/ionic stress), how it varies by metal and organism, and what mechanisms explain it; stops short of conservation consequences.

concepts/single-metal-dominance-versus-d.title: Single-metal dominance versus distributed metal-type diversity effects
concepts/single-metal-dominance-versus-d.description: Whether a metal-diversity association is driven by one metal, by within-genus outlier species, or is spread across metal types; covers leave-one-metal-out and within-genus variance tests.

concepts/small-cohort-and-phylogenetic-c.title: Small-cohort and phylogenetic confounding in lineage-level comparisons
concepts/small-cohort-and-phylogenetic-c.description: Statistical power, genus clumping, taxonomy tier mismatches and cohort-construction biases limiting lineage-level genome-content comparisons.

concepts/small-sample-limits-in-communit.title: Small-sample limits in community amplicon statistics
concepts/small-sample-limits-in-communit.description: How n=3 per group caps pairwise PERMANOVA and rank-test significance, how pooled and factorial designs recover power, and how replicate variability, low diversity and shallow depth limit ITS amplicon inference.

concepts/soil-metabolite-richness-under-.title: Soil metabolite richness under warming and substrate depletion
concepts/soil-metabolite-richness-under-.description: Changes in the number and identity of detectable metabolites in warmed soils, and interpretation through substrate-depletion models; stops at gene-level evidence.

concepts/sources-and-prevalence-of-eukar.title: Sources and prevalence of eukaryotic contamination in prokaryote-targeted metagenomes
concepts/sources-and-prevalence-of-eukar.description: How common eukaryotic reads are in environmental metagenomes, whether they are plastid or non-plastid, and how they differ by sample matrix; stops at the statistical handling of confounding.

concepts/spark-query-scale-limits-and-no.title: Spark query scale limits and notebook-session constraints in Lakehouse analyses
concepts/spark-query-scale-limits-and-no.description: Covers driver result-size caps, join and explode blow-ups, kernel and Spark Connect session timeouts, unpartitioned billion-row scans and string/decimal/numpy type surprises when moving data between Spark and pandas, with workarounds; stops at schema-specific gotchas and at catalog metadata access.

concepts/spatial-matching-of-environment.title: Spatial matching of environmental samples to genomes
concepts/spatial-matching-of-environment.description: Covers how proximity thresholds linking environmental measurements to genomes and spatial autocorrelation affect attribution of gene-content associations to measured sites; stops at the sensitivity analyses needed.

concepts/species-level-conservation-of-m.title: Species-level conservation of metabolic pathways across pangenomes
concepts/species-level-conservation-of-m.description: Whether GapMind pathway predictions on isolates generalize across genomes of a species, with clade-definition caveats; stops at pathogen genomes.

concepts/sphingolipid-and-shared-lpt-tra.title: Sphingolipid and shared Lpt transport in lipid A-deficient bacteria
concepts/sphingolipid-and-shared-lpt-tra.description: Whether sphingolipid biosynthesis is induced or constitutive during lipid A loss and whether the sphingolipid transporters share the LPS Lpt machinery; stops at Caulobacter transcript and proteome evidence.

concepts/statistical-power-and-database-.title: Statistical power and database coverage gap for archaeal trait analyses
concepts/statistical-power-and-database-.description: What can and cannot be concluded about archaea from phylogenetic comparative analyses given few archaeal genera with annotation data; covers power analysis and sampling bias toward cultured lineages.

concepts/structure-fitness-integration-o.title: Structure–fitness integration of mutant fitness data with predicted protein structures
concepts/structure-fitness-integration-o.description: Joining gene-level fitness measurements to AlphaFold models through SwissProt best hits to ask whether fitness-impact genes carry structural signatures; stops at the structural analyses themselves.

concepts/study-and-batch-confounding-of-.title: Study and batch confounding of cross-collection metadata correlates
concepts/study-and-batch-confounding-of-.description: Whether environment-metadata associations with a measured sample property survive when study/batch is held out; covers univariate versus out-of-study models and the recommended controls, not wet-lab mechanisms.

concepts/substrate-dependent-complex-i-r.title: Substrate-dependent Complex I requirement and NDH-2 compensation
concepts/substrate-dependent-complex-i-r.description: Whether Complex I (NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase) is needed specifically on aromatics or on any high-NADH-flux substrate, and the hypothesis that NDH-2 compensates elsewhere; stops at the evidence from ADP1 and ortholog-transferred fitness.

concepts/substrate-specificity-of-the-ma.title: Substrate specificity of the mannose PTS ManXYZ from genome-wide fitness
concepts/substrate-specificity-of-the-ma.description: What RB-TnSeq fitness across carbon sources shows about the ManXYZ phosphotransferase system versus fructose PTS in Escherichia coli K-12, including cofitness and annotation conflicts.

concepts/substudy-nesting-and-feature-le.title: Substudy nesting and feature leakage in pooled-cohort microbiome comparisons
concepts/substudy-nesting-and-feature-le.description: How cases and controls from different substudies make diagnosis collinear with study, how clustering on features later tested within clusters causes selection-on-outcome leakage, and which within-study designs repair them.

concepts/support-gene-networks-around-ca.title: Support-gene networks around catabolic pathways
concepts/support-gene-networks-around-ca.description: How many non-pathway genes (cofactor, respiration, iron, regulators) a substrate-specific catabolism requires, and how co-fitness assigns them to subsystems; stops at the aromatic case in one organism.

concepts/systematic-blind-spots-of-flux-.title: Systematic blind spots of flux balance models for condition-specific requirements
concepts/systematic-blind-spots-of-flux-.description: Where flux balance models miss condition-specific gene requirements (aromatic catabolism medium assumptions, cofactor supply, iron, respiratory capacity, threshold effects) and which genes lack reaction mappings; stops at growth-defect quantification among dispensable genes.

concepts/taxonomic-and-single-laboratory.title: Taxonomic and single-laboratory coverage limits of exometabolomic data
concepts/taxonomic-and-single-laboratory.description: How the small organism count, single-laboratory origin, uneven medium coverage and frozen snapshot limit statistical inference from exometabolomics databases.

concepts/taxonomic-distribution-and-rela.title: Taxonomic Distribution and Relative Prevalence of xoxF and mxaF Methanol Dehydrogenases
concepts/taxonomic-distribution-and-rela.description: Global and per-phylum/family prevalence of lanthanide-dependent xoxF versus calcium-dependent mxaF across bacterial and archaeal genomes, including carriage in non-canonical methylotroph lineages and phylogeny-corrected comparisons; stops at environmental drivers and marker calibration.

concepts/taxonomic-distribution-of-aroma.title: Taxonomic distribution of aromatic-compound catabolism
concepts/taxonomic-distribution-of-aroma.description: How predicted or enriched aromatic and phthalate degraders cluster in clades such as Burkholderiales, and whether versatility is a clade trait; inferred from genomes and taxonomy only.

concepts/taxonomic-resolution-and-refere.title: Taxonomic resolution and reference database limits in amplicon profiling
concepts/taxonomic-resolution-and-refere.description: How OTU versus exact-variant clustering and choice of 16S/ITS reference databases limit taxonomic assignment in amplicon studies.

concepts/taxonomic-synonymy-and-strain-n.title: Taxonomic synonymy and strain-name collisions in cross-database matching
concepts/taxonomic-synonymy-and-strain-n.description: Covers how renamed taxa, differing name formats and non-unique strain names split or falsely merge organisms when matching across cohorts and reference databases; stops at statistical confounding.

concepts/taxonomy-based-functional-infer.title: Taxonomy-based functional inference of biogeochemical processes and the redox ladder
concepts/taxonomy-based-functional-infer.description: Covers mapping 16S taxonomy to process potential, redox-ordered process hotspots and the limits of trait inference; stops at direct genomic or geochemical evidence.

concepts/taxonomy-bridging-between-metag.title: Taxonomy bridging between metagenomic classifiers and reference pangenomes
concepts/taxonomy-bridging-between-metag.description: How well community taxonomy calls map onto GTDB pangenome species and how ambiguity in the bridge affects community-weighted scores.

concepts/temporal-stability-of-groundwat.title: Temporal stability of groundwater communities
concepts/temporal-stability-of-groundwat.description: Covers short-term temporal versus spatial and filter-size variation in groundwater communities, and the lack of temporal replication in sediments.

concepts/thermodynamic-constraint-formul.title: Thermodynamic constraint formulation in flux balance models
concepts/thermodynamic-constraint-formul.description: How hard deltaG cutoffs versus concentration-aware TMFA constraints affect growth, flux, directionality and carbon-source growth predictions (12-condition panel) in genome-scale models.

concepts/training-set-size-and-the-shift.title: Training-set size and the shift from genome-scale to gene-specific predictive features
concepts/training-set-size-and-the-shift.description: How the number of genomes and genome-condition pairs determines whether interpretable models learn genome-size proxies or condition-specific genes, including correlated-feature grouping in SHAP attribution; it stops at external validation of the features.

concepts/transcript-protein-discordance-.title: Transcript-protein discordance and single-replicate proteomics limits
concepts/transcript-protein-discordance-.description: How far single-replicate outer-membrane proteome comparisons can be interpreted against transcript data, using Lpt, lptC2, Pal and related proteins; stops at inference limits and replication needs.

concepts/transposon-insertion-fitness-ve.title: Transposon insertion fitness versus gene deletion lethality
concepts/transposon-insertion-fitness-ve.description: Why RB-TnSeq (random barcode transposon sequencing) calls disagree with complete-deletion knockout essentiality, across thresholds, and what each method measures; stops at choice of continuous predictor.

concepts/universal-positivity-and-chemis.title: Universal positivity and chemistry-specific magnitude of metal cross-resistance
concepts/universal-positivity-and-chemis.description: Whether gene-level fitness effects of different metals correlate across bacteria, how strongly by metal pair, and how conserved this is across organisms; stops at gene-tier and pangenome questions.

concepts/universal-versus-variable-gene-.title: Universal versus variable gene essentiality across bacteria
concepts/universal-versus-variable-gene-.description: How many gene families are essential in every bacterium versus only in some, what that implies for minimal gene sets and drug targets, and where it stops (conservation in genomes is a separate concept).

concepts/unknown-function-genes-in-niche.title: Unknown-function genes in niche-differentiated accessory genomes
concepts/unknown-function-genes-in-niche.description: The large share of ecotype differentiation attributable to COG S (unknown function) genes and annotation gaps in niche-specific genes.

concepts/unmeasured-wet-lab-metadata-as-.title: Unmeasured wet-lab metadata as a limit on contamination correlates
concepts/unmeasured-wet-lab-metadata-as-.description: Missing extraction, host-depletion, filtration and library-prep metadata in public collections and what that prevents testing.

concepts/unstudied-protein-families-and-.title: Unstudied protein families and the literature-defined dark proteome
concepts/unstudied-protein-families-and-.description: How many protein families, defined by sequence clustering, have little or no literature, and how family size relates to literature coverage; stops at dark-family identification, not function assignment.

concepts/untapped-cross-program-synergy-.title: Untapped cross-program synergy use cases for environmental and clinical microbiology
concepts/untapped-cross-program-synergy-.description: Candidate analyses that use idle bridges between collections (subsurface prophages and metal resistance, pathogen environmental ecology, GTDB versus pangenome taxonomy, ontology coverage of biosamples) and the validation they need; stops at executed results.

concepts/validating-metal-tolerance-pred.title: Validating metal-tolerance predictions against culture-collection metadata
concepts/validating-metal-tolerance-pred.description: How small matched groups, culture-collection bias, taxonomy-bridge loss and tiny phenotype subsets limit validation of genome- or fitness-based metal-tolerance predictions against isolate isolation-environment metadata.

concepts/validity-of-curated-metal-gene-.title: Validity of curated metal-gene annotation
concepts/validity-of-curated-metal-gene-.description: How reliable curated KEGG-ortholog lists and curated HMMs are for annotating metal processing and resistance genes, including cross-reactivity, weak 'other' categories, category overlaps, substrate-binding transporter gaps and absence of manual validation.

concepts/warming-response-of-soil-microb.title: Warming response of soil microbial community composition
concepts/warming-response-of-soil-microb.description: Taxonomic shifts (phylum and genus level) in soil microbial communities under long-term experimental warming, by soil horizon; stops at functional gene-level responses.

concepts/within-species-metabolic-ecotyp.title: Within-species metabolic ecotypes from pathway variation
concepts/within-species-metabolic-ecotyp.description: Whether genomes of one species cluster by pathway completeness into metabolic ecotypes, how their number relates to pangenome openness, and whether they track environment.

concepts/within-species-subclade-segrega.title: Within-species subclade segregation of plant association and host specialization
concepts/within-species-subclade-segrega.description: Whether plant-associated genomes cluster in core-phylogeny subclades within species and segregate by plant host, including the genome-ID linkage failure and limited tree coverage.

concepts/within-species-variation-of-ant.title: Within-species variation of antimicrobial resistance gene content
concepts/within-species-variation-of-ant.description: How AMR gene prevalence is distributed across strains within a species (fixed, variable, rare), how it relates to pangenome class and openness, and where it stops: not co-occurrence or phylogeny.

concepts/within-study-environmental-driv.title: Within-study environmental drivers of eukaryotic DNA in soil metagenomes
concepts/within-study-environmental-driv.description: Batch-controlled variation of eukaryotic read fraction with vegetation and geography inside a single soil study; stops at one study and does not extend to aquatic or host-associated collections.

entities/3-hydroxybenzoic-acid.title: 3-Hydroxybenzoic acid
entities/3-hydroxybenzoic-acid.description: A groundwater-sourced hydroxybenzoate with the broadest genome-chassis capacity among callable compounds.

entities/4-hydroxybenzaldehyde.title: 4-Hydroxybenzaldehyde
entities/4-hydroxybenzaldehyde.description: A groundwater-sourced aromatic aldehyde with many predicted Sphingomonadales and Comamonas utilizers.

entities/abscisic-acid.title: Abscisic acid
entities/abscisic-acid.description: A terpenoid plant hormone with a single two-strain utilizer call.

entities/acc-deaminase-acds.title: ACC deaminase (acdS)
entities/acc-deaminase-acds.description: Plant growth-promoting enzyme that modulates plant ethylene signaling and marks root- and soil-associated bacteria.

entities/aciad3137-and-aciad2176.title: ACIAD3137 and ACIAD2176
entities/aciad3137-and-aciad2176.description: ADP1 uncharacterized proteins (UPF0234 and DUF2280) co-fit with Complex I at r > 0.98, candidate accessory factors.

entities/aciad3522.title: ACIAD3522
entities/aciad3522.description: ADP1 NADH-FMN oxidoreductase that is lethal when disrupted on acetate and of uncertain respiratory role.

entities/acidithiobacillus-ferrooxidans.title: Acidithiobacillus ferrooxidans
entities/acidithiobacillus-ferrooxidans.description: Leading bioleaching organism with no TnSeq data.

entities/acidobacteria.title: Acidobacteria
entities/acidobacteria.description: Phylum depleted in heated Harvard Forest organic soil.

entities/acinetobacter.title: Acinetobacter
entities/acinetobacter.description: Gram-negative bacterial genus enriched with Pseudomonas under lignin enrichment and favored by labile carbon.

entities/acinetobacter-baumannii.title: Acinetobacter baumannii
entities/acinetobacter-baumannii.description: Gram-negative pathogen that tolerates lipid A loss via PBP1A loss and Ld-transpeptidases and lacks sphingolipid biosynthesis.

entities/acinetobacter-baylyi-adp1.title: Acinetobacter baylyi ADP1
entities/acinetobacter-baylyi-adp1.description: Acinetobacter baylyi strain ADP1, a naturally competent soil bacterium with TnSeq, fitness, proteomics and metabolic-model data in a dedicated database.

entities/actinomycetota.title: Actinomycetota
entities/actinomycetota.description: A bacterial phylum in which contamination isolates show higher metal tolerance scores than environmental isolates.

entities/adp1-sqlite-database-berdl-tabl.title: ADP1 SQLite database (berdl_tables.db)
entities/adp1-sqlite-database-berdl-tabl.description: A 15-table SQLite database integrating genome, annotation, metabolic model, phenotype and proteomics data for ADP1 and 13 related genomes.

entities/adp1-to-pangenome-cluster-id-ma.title: ADP1 to pangenome cluster ID mapping
entities/adp1-to-pangenome-cluster-id-ma.description: A bridge joining ADP1 pangenome cluster IDs to Lakehouse gene clusters through member gene IDs.

entities/aerobic-respiration-and-chemota.title: Aerobic respiration and chemotaxis marker genes
entities/aerobic-respiration-and-chemota.description: coxABC and fliC/cheA/cheW markers strongly enriched in cultured genomes and absent from MAGs.

entities/aeromonas.title: Aeromonas
entities/aeromonas.description: Copiotrophic fast-growing bacterial genus enriched in lignin-plus-labile-carbon communities.

entities/aeromonas-veronii.title: Aeromonas veronii
entities/aeromonas-veronii.description: Species with the largest partial R² for isolation category in the GC analysis.

entities/aldehyde-dehydrogenase-k00128.title: Aldehyde dehydrogenase K00128
entities/aldehyde-dehydrogenase-k00128.description: Generic NAD-dependent aldehyde dehydrogenase (EC 1.2.1.3), a housekeeping enzyme whose presence alone drove spurious limonene-pathway enrichment.

entities/alphaearth-environmental-embedd.title: AlphaEarth environmental embeddings
entities/alphaearth-environmental-embedd.description: 64-dimension AlphaEarth geographic/environmental embeddings available for a subset of genomes, used to quantify environmental diversity and correlate environment with gene content.

entities/alphafold-msa-depth.title: AlphaFold MSA depth
entities/alphafold-msa-depth.description: The number of detectable homologous sequences in the multiple sequence alignment used by AlphaFold, a structural confidence metric used here as a proxy for evolutionary and annotation depth.

entities/alphafold-protein-structure-dat.title: AlphaFold Protein Structure Database
entities/alphafold-protein-structure-dat.description: Database of predicted protein structures for hundreds of millions of proteins, including the version-6 MSA depth snapshot used here.

entities/alternative-nadh-dehydrogenase-.title: Alternative NADH dehydrogenase NDH-2
entities/alternative-nadh-dehydrogenase-.description: Non-proton-pumping NADH dehydrogenase that can substitute for Complex I at low NADH flux.

entities/aluminum.title: Aluminum
entities/aluminum.description: Trivalent metal that was the most independent in the cross-resistance consensus.

entities/aminobacter.title: Aminobacter
entities/aminobacter.description: Bacterial genus known for aromatic amine metabolism, appearing only in Round 2 lignin-history groups.

entities/amrfinderplus.title: AMRFinderPlus
entities/amrfinderplus.description: Tool annotating known resistance genes, which may underestimate novel environmental resistance.

entities/anaeromyxobacter-dehalogenans.title: Anaeromyxobacter dehalogenans
entities/anaeromyxobacter-dehalogenans.description: Iron- and uranium-reducing bacterium, a model ENIGMA organism, abundant in sediment.

entities/anaerostipes-caccae.title: Anaerostipes caccae
entities/anaerostipes-caccae.description: Canonical butyrate-producing gut commensal that anchors the Crohn's pathobiont module in E1 and may be incidentally affected by pathobiont depletion.

entities/antimicrobial-resistance-gene-c.title: Antimicrobial resistance gene catalog (amr_fitness_cost)
entities/antimicrobial-resistance-gene-c.description: Catalog of AMR genes in Fitness Browser organisms with per-gene fitness costs.

entities/arginine.title: Arginine
entities/arginine.description: Amino acid with four-way database concordance and 270 fitness genes in FW300-N2E3, also appearing in community metabolic ecology.

entities/arkinlab-dbcan.title: arkinlab_dbcan
entities/arkinlab-dbcan.description: Dataset with family-level dbCAN CAZyme annotations covering only 1,161 MGnify genomes (2.3% of the catalog).

entities/arsenic-resistance-ars-genes.title: Arsenic resistance ars genes
entities/arsenic-resistance-ars-genes.description: The ars gene family (arsD, arsC, arsN) conferring arsenic resistance, including arsC arsenate reductase as a marker in cultured genomes versus subsurface MAGs.

entities/aspo-hard-rock-laboratory-and-o.title: Aspo Hard Rock Laboratory and Olkiluoto
entities/aspo-hard-rock-laboratory-and-o.description: Underground research labs appearing as site-specific isolation-source labels.

entities/ausmicrobiome.title: AusMicrobiome
entities/ausmicrobiome.description: Australian soil amplicon survey whose genera formed the subset used for the genomic-density and soil-metal replications.

entities/azospira.title: Azospira
entities/azospira.description: Denitrifying genus with high groundwater prevalence and high metal-type diversity.

entities/azospirillum-brasilense.title: Azospirillum brasilense
entities/azospirillum-brasilense.description: Alphaproteobacterium with all 18 amino acid pathways complete in GapMind.

entities/bacdive.title: BacDive
entities/bacdive.description: Strain database whose environment categories were approximated by a rule-based classifier for comparing AMR burden.

entities/bacillota-a.title: Bacillota_A
entities/bacillota-a.description: GTDB phylum in which CAZyme density correlates most strongly with pangenome openness.

entities/bacillota-b.title: Bacillota_B
entities/bacillota-b.description: GTDB phylum-level lineage of anaerobic Firmicutes, including Desulfosporosinus and Desulforudis, compared between deep-clay and soil genomes.

entities/bacillus-subtilis-168.title: Bacillus subtilis 168
entities/bacillus-subtilis-168.description: Firmicutes model proposed as top new organism for transposon library construction, though not selected by conservation covering-set analysis.

entities/bacterial-nitrogen-fixation-nif.title: Bacterial nitrogen fixation (nif genes)
entities/bacterial-nitrogen-fixation-nif.description: The nitrogenase nifHDK operon (KEGG module M00175), including nifH as a marker, used as a plant-growth-promoting and nitrogen-fixation marker.

entities/bacteriophage-lambda.title: Bacteriophage lambda
entities/bacteriophage-lambda.description: Enterobacterial phage that enters Escherichia coli through the ManYZ pore, used as the model for the SNIPE and man-mutant resistance trade-off.

entities/bacteroides-thetaiotaomicron.title: Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron
entities/bacteroides-thetaiotaomicron.description: Sole Bacteroidetes among the 14 organisms, with the lowest annotation-gap resolution.

entities/bacteroides-xylanisolvens.title: Bacteroides xylanisolvens
entities/bacteroides-xylanisolvens.description: Gut Bacteroidota species clustered into 6 gene-content ecotypes with silhouette 0.366.

entities/bacteroidota.title: Bacteroidota
entities/bacteroidota.description: Bacterial phylum with the most GH-skewed CAZyme profiles; soil members carry the highest GH counts.

entities/bagnoud-et-al-2016-opalinus-por.title: Bagnoud et al. 2016 Opalinus porewater food web
entities/bagnoud-et-al-2016-opalinus-por.description: Published metagenomic and metaproteomic Mont Terri porewater study with MAGs recurring across seven boreholes, used as the porewater paradigm.

entities/bakta.title: Bakta
entities/bakta.description: Genome annotation tool whose alternative EC and product annotations were queried for dark reactions.

entities/bakta-amr.title: bakta_amr
entities/bakta-amr.description: Bakta AMR annotation table in the pangenome data used for Tier 1 resistance gene identification.

entities/bakta-pfam-domains.title: bakta_pfam_domains
entities/bakta-pfam-domains.description: Lakehouse table of Bakta Pfam domain hits (18.8M rows) with versioned accessions; misses classical defense markers.

entities/bayesian-binomial-glmm.title: Bayesian binomial GLMM
entities/bayesian-binomial-glmm.description: Variational-Bayes binomial generalized linear mixed model with phylum and family random intercepts for phylogeny-aware testing.

entities/beril-realized-use-audit.title: BERIL realized-use audit
entities/beril-realized-use-audit.description: A README-based mining of 66 BERIL projects to count tenant and database usage and overlay it on theoretical bridges.

entities/beyelii-yar-borehole.title: Beyelii Yar borehole
entities/beyelii-yar-borehole.description: Russian borehole contributing two deep-clay anchor genomes.

entities/biased-gene-conversion.title: Biased gene conversion
entities/biased-gene-conversion.description: Recombination-associated process favoring GC alleles, proposed as a driver of ecology-linked GC differences.

entities/bidirectional-best-blast-hit-or.title: bidirectional best BLAST hit orthology
entities/bidirectional-best-blast-hit-or.description: Ortholog inference by reciprocal best BLAST hits, with connected components used to form ortholog groups.

entities/black-queen-hypothesis.title: Black Queen Hypothesis
entities/black-queen-hypothesis.description: Hypothesis (Morris et al. 2012) that costly genes are lost when community members supply their functions as public goods.

entities/borreliella-burgdorferi.title: Borreliella burgdorferi
entities/borreliella-burgdorferi.description: Spirochaetota pilot species with a multi-partite genome, flagged as an outlier breaking the direction test.

entities/bradyrhizobium.title: Bradyrhizobium
entities/bradyrhizobium.description: Soil genus whose NEON MAGs carry partial limonene-pathway KOs (including K14733) also present in cultured pangenomes.

entities/branched-chain-amino-acid-biosy.title: Branched-chain amino acid biosynthesis reactions rxn02185 and rxn03436
entities/branched-chain-amino-acid-biosy.description: Acetolactate pyruvate-lyase and acetohydroxy acid isomeroreductase steps in valine/isoleucine biosynthesis, most frequently resolved gaps.

entities/brex.title: BREX
entities/brex.description: Bacteriophage exclusion defense system characterized in 2015.

entities/brh-c8a-peptococcaceae-c8a.title: BRH-c8a (Peptococcaceae c8a)
entities/brh-c8a-peptococcaceae-c8a.description: Peptococcaceae lineage (Bagnoud's c8a) in the deep clay cohort, matched to Mont Terri MAGs recurring across boreholes.

entities/burkholderia-vietnamiensis.title: Burkholderia vietnamiensis
entities/burkholderia-vietnamiensis.description: High-GC soil, plant and clinical bacterium used as a case study of within-species GC ecology.

entities/burkholderiales.title: Burkholderiales
entities/burkholderiales.description: A betaproteobacterial order whose genera dominate predicted aromatic-catabolism versatility and periphyton abundance.

entities/bv-brc.title: BV-BRC
entities/bv-brc.description: Bacterial and Viral Bioinformatics Resource Center, whose plasmid accessions were used to validate plasmid enrichment of metal-resistance KOs.

entities/cadmium.title: Cadmium
entities/cadmium.description: Toxic metal with no significant core enrichment, one organism.

entities/campylobacterota.title: Campylobacterota
entities/campylobacterota.description: Bacterial phylum with the weakest adaptive-to-housekeeping multi-copy ratio and streamlined accessory genomes.

entities/candidatus-desulforudis-audaxvi.title: Candidatus Desulforudis audaxviator
entities/candidatus-desulforudis-audaxvi.description: Self-sufficient subsurface sulfate-reducing Bacillota_B bacterium whose genome is in the deep-clay anchor cohort.

entities/candidatus-jorgensenbacteria.title: Candidatus Jorgensenbacteria
entities/candidatus-jorgensenbacteria.description: Patescibacteria (CPR) lineage ubiquitous in the ORFRC groundwater dataset.

entities/canonical-correlation-analysis.title: canonical correlation analysis
entities/canonical-correlation-analysis.description: Multivariate method used on principal-component scores to find joint species-metabolite axes in paired HMP2 subjects.

entities/canonical-giy-yig-nuclease-fami.title: Canonical GIY-YIG nuclease family (PF01541)
entities/canonical-giy-yig-nuclease-fami.description: Pfam PF01541 / IPR000305, a large nuclease family of restriction and DNA repair enzymes that is not the SNIPE nuclease.

entities/carbon-source-phenotypes-corpus.title: Carbon Source Phenotypes corpus
entities/carbon-source-phenotypes-corpus.description: Literature-curated binary growth phenotypes for 795 genomes across 379 conditions, used as a pretraining corpus.

entities/card-antibiotic-resistance-onto.title: CARD Antibiotic Resistance Ontology
entities/card-antibiotic-resistance-onto.description: Ontology of antibiotic resistance determinants proposed for improving mechanism classification.

entities/caulobacter-crescentus.title: Caulobacter crescentus
entities/caulobacter-crescentus.description: Alphaproteobacterium used as the model in which Δlpxc (lipid A loss) is viable on a Δfur background with anionic sphingolipids.

entities/caulobacter-sphingolipid-biosyn.title: Caulobacter sphingolipid biosynthesis pathway
entities/caulobacter-sphingolipid-biosyn.description: Serine palmitoyltransferase (spt), ceramide synthase and ceramide reductase pathway producing anionic sphingolipids; present in Caulobacter and absent from comparator Gram-negatives.

entities/cazy-glycoside-hydrolase-to-gly.title: CAZy glycoside hydrolase to glycosyl transferase ratio
entities/cazy-glycoside-hydrolase-to-gly.description: Proposed ecological indicator contrasting degradative (GH) and biosynthetic (GT) CAZymes per genome to describe dominant carbohydrate strategy.

entities/cbass.title: CBASS
entities/cbass.description: Cyclic-oligonucleotide-based anti-phage signaling system; sparse across phyla and independent of CRISPR-Cas.

entities/cbb3-fix-micro-aerobic-respirat.title: cbb3/fix micro-aerobic respiratory operon
entities/cbb3-fix-micro-aerobic-respirat.description: Caulobacter cbb3 oxidase, cyd and fix-NOPQ operon (CCNA_01466-01476) whose Δfur response is buffered by ΔsspB.

entities/chebi.title: ChEBI
